articleTitle: Analyzing Memory Access Traces of Deep Learning Workloads for Efficient Memory Management
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Due to the recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) and high-performance computing technologies, deep learning is actively used in various application domains of the fourth industrial revolution. Since the data size of deep learning increasingly grows, analyzing the memory reference characteristics of AI workloads becomes important. In this article, we analyze the memory access traces of deep learning workloads consisting of text and image data. Specifically, we analyze read and write operations separately for instruction and data memory accesses. Based on our analysis, we find out the following characteristics that are quite different to memory access traces of conventional desktop workloads. First, when comparing instruction and data accesses, instruction access accounts for a little portion of memory accesses in deep learning workloads, which is quite different from traditional workloads. Specifically, instruction access accounts for 1-3.3% in deep learning workloads while 15-30% in traditional workloads. Second, when comparing read and write accesses, write access accounts for 64-80%, which is also different to traditional workloads where write accounts for 6-55%. Third, although write access accounts for the majority of memory accesses, it exhibits the low access skewness. Specifically, the Zipf parameter of write access is about 0.3, and the parameter is smaller in text workloads than image workloads. Fourth, in predicting re-reference likelihood, recency ranking is important in instruction and data read accesses, but frequency ranking is necessary in write accesses for accurate estimation. We expect that the characterization study in this article will guide for managing memory systems of deep learning workloads.

articleTitle: Reducing the Overhead of Virtual Memory Swapping by Considering Application Characteristics and Memory Situations
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: As the number of mobile apps continues to increase, the overhead of virtual memory swapping in smartphones is becoming increasingly heavy. Unlike desktop or server systems, the default setting of smartphones does not support swapping, and thus apps are terminated in case there are no available memory space. This is because enabling the swapping function in smartphones accompanies large overhead through storage accesses. In this paper, we present a new swapping policy for smartphones that reduces the overhead of storage accesses significantly. Specifically, our policy considers application characteristics and memory situations to adjust the number of processes to be swapped. To do so, we monitor the current memory situation and determine whether supporting swapping or not for the apps in execution. Measurement studies with Android reference phones through executing 24 popular mobile apps show that the proposed policy reduces the overhead of swapping significantly.

articleTitle: Flower image classification based on improved convolutional neural network
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This paper attempts to apply neural networks to classify flower images. The construction of the classification model is based on thousands of actual flower pictures, including Daisy, Dandelion, Rose, Sunflower, and Tulip. Convolutional Neural Network, or CNN, is often used in the analysis of visual images and has a good application in the classification and prediction of flower images. This paper analyzes the models and algorithms used in our experiments. By improving and optimizing the data set and neural network structure, we have achieved a better model structure and further enhanced the accuracy of flower prediction. The final training accuracy rate exceeded 91%.

articleTitle: Application Research and Challenges of Artificial Intelligence in Primary and Secondary Education
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the rise and development of artificial intelligence, artificial intelligence technology has been widely used in various fields such as medical care, agriculture, finance, social security, and home furnishing. Of course, the field of education is no exception. Vigorously developing artificial intelligence education in primary and secondary schools is a new requirement for the development of the times. First of all, this study briefly describes the concept and research field of artificial intelligence. Secondly, this study makes an in-depth analysis of the development process and application scenarios of artificial intelligence education in primary and secondary schools. Thirdly, it puts forward the challenges in the development process of artificial intelligence education in primary and secondary schools at the present stage. Finally, we hope that this study can provide a reference for the research of artificial intelligence education in primary and secondary schools in China.

articleTitle: MTBC-BioNER: Multi-task Learning Using BioBERT and CharCNN for Biomedical Named Entity Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In recent years, a large amount of biomedical text data has been generated with the rapid development of biomedical technology and computer technology. How to effectively process these data has become an important issue. Biomedical Named Entity Recognition (BioNER) is an important task in biomedical text information processing. It has an important impact on its downstream tasks, such as entity relation extraction, question answering systems, document classification, etc. However, existing works only relying on a single deep learning model are difficult to learn feature representations for biomedical text data. This paper proposes MTBC-BioNER model, which combines multi-task learning methods to train different related tasks at the same time, and combines the contextual word embedding vector generated by Biomedical Bidirectional Encoder Representation from Transformers (BioBERT) with the character embedding vector generated by Character-level Convolution Neural Network (CharCNN) to effectively represent the feature information of biomedical entities. This model regards each data set in 15 biomedical data sets as an independent task, and uses a specific module for different tasks. Through joint training of all data sets, the model can obtain common features among different tasks, so as to improve the universality of the model. Experiments on 15 biomedical datasets show the effectiveness of MTBC-BioNER.

articleTitle: Research on mathematics test questions of high school entrance examination based on the SOLO taxonomy theory : Take the 2019-2021 Jinan high school entrance examination questions as an example
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The high school entrance examination is the most important examination that junior middle school students face in their three-year study and life, which is of great significance to them. The analysis of high school entrance examination papers can help teachers carry out targeted teaching, so as to achieve better results. Based on the SOLO taxonomy theory, this paper analyzes the thinking level of Jinan high school entrance examination mathematics questions from 2019 to 2021, and divides the contents of the questions according to the curriculum standards, so as to analyze the proposition rules and characteristics of the high school entrance examination questions.Through the analysis, it is found that the content of Jinan high school entrance examination is relatively stable, and the Uni- structural level, Multi-structural level, Relational level and Extended Abstract level are examined on average. The most examined is the Multi-structural level, and the least is the Extended Abstract level; The knowledge points of the examination questions involve seven fields: number and formula, equation and inequality, function, the nature of the graph, the change of the graph, the coordinates of the graph, and statistics and probability. The examination direction is clear, all fields are grasped together, the content distribution is relatively balanced, the focus is prominent, and the goal is clear; The difficulty of the test questions tends to become simpler, not blindly pursuing difficult problems. In order to promote the further development of students' thinking level, corresponding teaching suggestions are put forward based on the research conclusions, so as to improve the teaching effect.

articleTitle: Smoke Segmentation based on Weakly Supervised Semantic Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Smoke detection and segmentation are essential in fire warning, air pollution, and other fields. The most advanced smoke segmentation method is supervised based on deep learning. However, the supervised method requires a lot of data and accurate labels. Especially for smoke segmentation tasks, pixel-level labeling is difficult. To solve this problem, an improved weak supervised semantic segmentation method is proposed to generate high-quality smoke pixel labels. In this paper, a branch attention module is designed to fuse multiple-dilation-rate convolutions automatically. Then, the variable Gaussian modulation module proposed in this paper is used to enhance secondary convolution characteristics to generate a more comprehensive class activation map. Finally, experiments are carried out on existing synthetic smoke datasets. The results show that our method can significantly improve the smoke extraction performance.

articleTitle: Research and Practice on Detection of Abnormal Campus Accounts Based on User Sign-in Logs of Business Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In recent years, information security has been getting more concerned, and timely detection of abnormal campus accounts has great significance to the information security of colleges and universities. This paper proposes an abnormal campus accounts detection method using a machine learning model to detect abnormal campus accounts that have suspicious activities, and uses the quantity and the percentage of user sign-in logs of different campus business systems to detect accounts that have unusual access behaviors. This paper uses user sign-in logs of campus business systems for 9 consecutive months and the known abnormal campus accounts as data sources, and generates samples based on the proposed method to train the machine learning models, then verifies the detection effect of the trained machine learning models. The results show that the proposed method achieves a detection rate of up to 75% with a false-positive rate of 0.26% in identifying abnormal campus accounts.

Author Keywords: login frequency of campus business systems

articleTitle: Exploration on the teaching of performance design studio in Colleges and Universities Based on the concept of OBE
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Achievement oriented education, or OBE for short, has become an advanced concept of innovative professional education in European and American countries. Based on the concept of OBE and combined with the professional course of "performance and design", this paper discusses in detail the process of using the concept to formulate the teaching objectives, teaching contents, teaching methods, teaching practice and teaching evaluation of the performance design course. It is established that using OBE concept, taking design studio as teaching platform, and carrying out professional education with clear goal orientation can improve students' self-learning ability and innovation ability, and enhance their sense of achievement.

articleTitle: Classification of the Stress Levels Based on Heartbeat Evoked Potentials – a Pilot Study
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: It is known that emotion affects the brain signals (e.g., EEG) and heart rate variability (HRV). However, few studies have explored how the heartbeat-evoked potentials (HEPs) may relate to stress, a type of emotion. Here we show that the features extracted from the HEPs can be used to classify the low and high stress levels induced using a mental arithmetic (MA) paradigm. The HEPs were derived from 22 channels of scalp EEGs and one channel of ECGs simultaneously recorded when the subjects were solving the simple or complex MA problems. The feature matrix was constructed from the HEP epochs differing significantly between the two types of MA problems. Among three machine learning models, the best average classification accuracy reaches 99.89%.

articleTitle: Multi-label Feature Selection Based on Fuzzy Neighborhood Mutual Discrimination Index
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Multi-label feature selection advances the performance of multi-label classification models by eliminating irrelevant and redundant features. Most multi-label feature selection algorithms assume that the training set containing logical labels, which means that labels are equally important for instances. However, in practical applications, there are different importances of labels. To solve the problem, we proposes a multi-label feature selection method based on fuzzy neighborhood mutual discriminant index. Firstly, logical labels are transformed into label distribution by label enhancement. Secondly, the information entropy is referenced to the label distribution learning, the label neighborhood similarity matrix is constructed to describe the ambiguity between labels. Finally, linking the fuzzy neighborhood discrimination index under the selected feature subset with label neighborhood similarity matrix is proposed, which is used for judging the distinguishing ability of the feature subset to label. Comprehensive experiments on 6 multi-label datasets show that the algorithm outperforms other algorithms in classification performance.

articleTitle: Design of Graphic Interactive Experimental Platform Based on MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Aiming at consolidating theoretical knowledge and improving actual ability, the paper directs at solving the unreadability of digital signal processing courses, such as intricate abstract concepts, various mathematical formulas, disable learning difficulties and so on. The paper puts forward to designing a platform based on MATLAB digital processing. Easy-operating, direct and perceptual platform improves the teaching quality and effects of the courses to a certain degree. It can also be extended as an experimental platform for other courses.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Streaming Feature Selection Based on FDAF-score
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In many practical classification scenarios, the data label space has a hierarchical structure, these data often have high-dimensional features, and there are irrelevant and redundant features. Thus, a variety of hierarchical classification feature selection methods are proposed. However, most of the existing algorithms ignore the temporal uncertainty and unknown of the feature space, and can only deal with static feature space data. Therefore, a new hierarchical streaming feature selection method is proposed. First, the algorithm uses the sibling strategy and the exclusion strategy in the hierarchical relationship to consider the relationship between homogeneous and heterogeneous samples. Then, the FDAF-score algorithm is integrated into the hierarchical classification streaming feature selection and used as a criterion for evaluating feature importance. Second, the improved Gaussian kernel function is used to judge the degree of redundancy between features, and the redundant features are removed. Finally, experiments on six hierarchical classification data sets show the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Syndrome Classification Based on Multi-Graph Attention Network
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Syndrome classification is an important step in Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) for diagnosis and treatment. In this paper, we propose a multi-graph attention network (MGAT) based method to simulate TCM doctors to infer the syndromes. Specifically, the complex relationships between symptoms and state elements are aggregated using graph attention networks (GAT) and syndromes are classified by a multilayer perceptron (MLP). To verify the effectiveness of the model, extensive experiments are conducted on the Treatise on Febrile Diseases dataset. The experimental results show that the proposed method outperforms several typical methods in terms of accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. The MGAT model has high accuracy in syndrome classification and has practical application value.

articleTitle: Leveraging Autoencoder and Focal Loss for Imbalanced Data Classification
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)v
abstract: Class-imbalance is common occurrence in the machine learning and data mining community. Many classification algorithms often fail to learn the minority class information when encountering imbalanced data, resulting in the model being biased towards the majority class. Most importantly, existing learning algorithms mainly concern the class-imbalance distribution, and do not take into account the small number of samples, high feature dimensions, and other issues. To this end, this paper presents a new learning paradigm for solving above problems. To be specific, we first utilize Autoencoder to achieve dimensionality reduction and extract most discriminative features. Next, we explore focal loss to solve the class-imbalance issue and obtain better classification capability. Finally, we tackle the black-box optimization problem via Bayesian Optimization and find a suitable parameters for classification. Extensive experiments performed on three real-world datasets show our method achieves better performance.

Index Terms: Area Under Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve

articleTitle: Cross Attention with Transformer for Few-shot Medical Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Few-shot medical segmentation aims at learning to segment a new organ object using only a few annotated support images of the target class, which require the network to have strong generalization performance in extremely few data regimes. There exists a groundbreaking idea of integrating meta-learning methods into few-shot medical image segmentation. However, existing few-shot medical image segmentation methods fail to consider the global anatomy correlation between the support and query set. The information exchange between two branches is too weak to fully carry out a sufficient semantic understanding. This determines how much knowledge the query set learns from the corresponding support set. To alleviate the above-mentioned drawbacks, we propose a novel Cross Attention network based on traditional two-branch methods. Our starting point is to fully integrate the global information of the two parts with the frequently used fusion method in cross-modality tasks. To achieve this goal, we raised two main contributions: (1) The transformer-based Cross Attention module is leveraged to strengthen the fusion of support and query data. and (2) Through the comparable results on two challenging datasets (abdominal segmentation dataset CHAOS and cardiac segmentation dataset MS-CMRSeg), we proved that the traditional meta-learning based methods still have great potential when strengthening the information exchange between two branches. We achieve remarkable improvement in the proposed method compared with currently dominant metric learning-based methods.

articleTitle: A Probe into the Hybrid Teaching Mode of Advanced Mathematics Based on "Adaptive Learning"
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Advanced Mathematics, as an important basic subject, is a basic compulsory course to all engineering majors. In order to improve the teaching effect of "Higher Mathematics" and cultivate personalized innovative talents, this paper discusses the blended teaching mode based on "adaptive learning". On the basis of using modern information technology to improve "teaching and learning environment" and "teaching and learning methods", this paper studies the customization of personalized learning content and learning objectives, and realizes the transformation from "teaching-oriented" to "learning-oriented" in higher mathematics, so as to give full play to students' subjective initiative as possible. Finally, by comparing the blended teaching with the traditional teaching, it is found that the blended teaching based on "adaptive learning" greatly improves the teaching effect and can be widely used in practical teaching.

articleTitle: Hierarchical online streaming feature selection based on adaptive ReliefF
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In hierarchical classification learning, the feature space of data has high dimensionality, and the feature space is unknown with emerging features. To solve the above problems, we proposes an online streaming feature selection algorithm for hierarchical classification based on the adaptive ReliefF. Firstly, the ReliefF is adaptively improved by using the density information of instances around the sample, making it unnecessary to pre-specify parameters. Secondly, the hierarchical relationship between classes is integrated into the algorithm, and a new method for calculating the feature weight of hierarchical data is defined. Then, a feature online importance analysis method is designed based on feature weight. Finally, the adaptive ReliefF algorithm is improved based on feature redundancy, and the feature weight is scaled by the correlation between the features to achieve dynamic feature redundancy update. A large number of experiments verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Global output feedback control for a class of general nonlinear systems with input matching uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)v
abstract: This paper is concerned with the global stabilization problem via adaptive output-feedback for a class of uncertain nonlinear systems. Different from the closely related literature, the system under investigation possesses input matching uncertainty and the unknown constant multiplied by the polynomial of output-input growth rate. To solve the problem, an extended state observer is constructed by introducing dynamic high-gain to effectively counteract the negative effects of input matching uncertainty. Particularly, only one dynamic gain is introduced to deal with the serious unknowns and the polynomial of output-input in the growth rate. Based on the high-gain observer, an adaptive output-feedback controller is designed to make all the states of the closed-loop system globally converge to zero. A numerical example is provided to illustrate the effectiveness of the theoretical results.

articleTitle: Design of an Intelligent Water Quality Warning System
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The detection of abnormal water resource data is a key link in water resource information processing and system decision-making, a prerequisite for the normal operation of the water intake information monitoring system, and an important support for promoting the management and construction of water resources in smart cities. With the development of the Internet of things, the internet and big data technology, the informatization process of the water resources system has been accelerating, and the authenticity of data has become increasingly prominent. The detection of outliers in water resources big data is facing new challenges. As the population grows and the level of urbanization increases, the problem of water resources in China is becoming more and more urgent. The traditional anomaly detection mode mostly adopts manual sampling, which has low efficiency and high error rate, and cannot meet the needs of anomaly detection of massive water intake data. A remote monitoring method of water resources based on Internet of things (IoT) technology and electronic measurement technology is proposed in this paper to achieve remote monitoring of water resources effectively, in which the collection device uploads data to the server and stores it in the database, and the terminal can retrieve monitoring information over a period of time, while different threshold ranges can be set to achieve the role of timely alarm, which is convenient for staff to deal with in a timely manner.

articleTitle: Research on factors related to management effect based on chronic disease management platform
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)v
abstract: Objective: To initially explore which factors are related to the blood pressure changes in the process of chronic disease management on the platform. Methods: A total of 742 eligible hypertensive patients from the Health Community Group of Yuhuan People's Hospital were selected. First, we found the turning point at which the overall management effect of the platform reached a higher level according to continuous blood pressure. Then we divided the patients into three groups according to the management effect and compared the demographic characteristics and the physiological indicators in the two assessments of each group. Results: In the group with better management effect, there was a higher proportion of women, a higher average number of blood pressure measurements, and a higher proportion of patients over 40-60 years old; the group with worse management effect had a higher proportion of patients over 60 years old. As for the evaluation data, only the distribution of serum creatinine had a statistically significant relationship with the management effect. Conclusions: It is preliminarily explored that in the process of management, the number of blood pressure measurements may be the behavioral factor, gender and age may be the demographic factors affecting the management effect; homocysteine, total cholesterol, intima-media thickness, microalbuminuria may be physiological indicators that change with blood pressure during the management process.

articleTitle: Hash learning with approximate distance
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Hash-based method is important in large-scale image retrieval method, since it can greatly reduce the cost of storage and retrieval. The main idea of hash method is to map data into hash codes that preserve the original data information. In recent years, many unsupervised hash methods pay attention to the adjacency of different distance metric and aim at keeping the adjacency in the hash code and original space consistent. Euclidean distance is the most common distance metric. The nearest neighbor relationship in Euclidean distance has become the focus of many unsupervised hash methods. However, many hash codes generated under Euclidean distance will lose a lot of information so that have low ability to learn the nearest neighbor relationship. To solve the problem, an approximate distance formula is designed in this paper. Theoretically, approximate distance formula can make up for information loss caused by quantization functions, so that the nearest neighbor relationship under the Euclidean distance can be better preserved. The experiment also verifies that the hash methods using the approximate distance formula have better ability of nearest neighbor search.

articleTitle: Research Status, Challenges and Countermeasures of Robot Education Application in Primary and Secondary Schools
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of information technology, the era of artificial intelligence has arrived. As one of the most representative technologies in artificial intelligence technology, robotics has set off a wave in the field of education. Robot education has been introduced into primary and secondary schools as a new education system. This research first briefly expounds the related concepts and research status of robot education, and then deeply analyzes the research status of robot education in primary and secondary schools in terms of theory and practice. We hope that this study can provide theoretical basis and practical significance for the research on robotics education in primary and secondary schools in my country.

articleTitle: Research on teaching service platform based on SPOC teaching platform
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In the new century with the rapid development of information technology, the existing online education platforms have some problems, such as lack of individuation, poor supervision of implementation and weak development of thinking. With the continuous development of artificial intelligence technology, online education platforms such as SPOC and MOOC, Making the need for advanced online education platforms even more urgent, Especially in the face of the current severe epidemic, it is extremely important to explore and design advanced online education platforms. To this end, Based on the existing SPOC, MOOC and other teaching platforms, this paper analyzes the existing problems and gives solutions, Design a new SPOC teaching service platform to adapt to students' personalized learning and supervised learning, We will improve the quality of education and teaching services in the new era.

Author Keywords: Teaching service platform design About the Author

articleTitle: Design of Wrist Rehabilitation Robot
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: We have developed a wrist rehabilitation manipulator to help patients with wrist injuries during exercise achieve sustained and standardized rehabilitation. Based on the theory of rehabilitation medicine, a 3RRP spherical parallel three-dimensional exoskeleton repair manipulator was developed. According to the principle of ergonomics, the shape safety of the robot was optimized. The virtual prototype system is used to simulate the rehabilitation manipulator and MATLAB is used to operate the recovery manipulator. The simulation results show that the designed manipulator has three degrees of freedom, which can meet our needs. The working area is part of the spherical area, and there is no cavity. The appearance, color and humanistic dimension can enable patients to obtain better treatment experience. Conclusion: It provides some basis for the industrial design of manipulator.

articleTitle: The TCM medication rule analysis for emotional diseases caused by panic disorder based on data mining
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Prescriptions found in ancient and modern medical books were analyzed in this study, and the medication rules were mined to provide effective guidance for the clinical treatment of emotional diseases and modern psychosomatic diseases. First, 101 prescriptions of panic disease were extracted, including 217 traditional Chinese medicines with a total frequency of 1154. Second, the medication rules of these prescriptions were analyzed by data mining methods, such as frequency statistics, association rules mining and cluster analysis. The results indicated that four herbal medicines, namely Polygala, Poria, Angelica Sinensis and Semen Ziziphi Spinosae, were used more than 30 times. For medicines whose usage frequency ≥ 0.5%, their four properties were warm, flat, slightly cold and cold; the Jive tastes were sweet, bitter and pungent; and their channel tropisms were mainly heart, lung, liver and spleen. There were five drug pairs used frequently including Semen Ziziphi Spinosae-Polygala, Liquorice-Poria, which were found by association rules analysis. The drug pairs with higher correlation coefficient were for sedation, qi-regulating and qi-tonifying. The clustering results were composed of three clusters: nourishing heart and quieting spirit, qi-regulating and cholagogue, and accelerating blood circulation.

articleTitle: Impact analysis of COVID-19 pandemic on students' online exams based on topic model
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: To deal with the COVID-19 pandemic, schools at all levels insist on "classes suspended but learning continues" and actively implement online teaching. Different from the planned shift from offline to online education, COVID-19 caused online teaching to be highly sudden and emergent, producing different learning outcomes from offline teaching. Therefore, it is critical to analyze the epidemic's impact on students' learning outcomes. However, prior studies only focus on statistical data of the learning process, such as students' test scores or homework completion, rather than comments posted on social media. This paper explores the impact of COVID-19 on students' online exams by identifying potential topics during the final exam period. We first collect and preprocess a huge number of Weibo posts with natural language processing methods. Then, we explore related topics via LDA (Latent Dirichlet Allocation) model. Finally, the extensive experimental results demonstrate that our findings for the 16 topic groups have significant roles in exploring students' attitudes towards online exams and exam cheating. Furthermore, we found that the overall affective attitudes of users' postings tended to be negative.

articleTitle: The reform of online and offline hybrid teaching mode of higher mathematics
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Taking higher mathematics as an example, this paper analyzes the necessity of the reform of the teaching mode of higher mathematics, and discusses the whole process of the implementation of the teaching mode from three aspects: before class, during class and after class. Taking a specific class as an example, this paper shows the teaching process, and gives the teaching effect after adopting the online and offline hybrid teaching mode.

articleTitle: Design of the Smart Bedside Table Based on Single-Chip Microcomputer
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the popularization of smart home, nightstand plays an increasingly important role in people’s daily life. By means of questionnaire survey and data collection, it is found that most household nightstands only play the role of storage, the bedroom space is always not enough for all kinds of furniture, the nightstand cannot be interconnected with other smart devices. The existing smart nightstands on the market have common problems: uneven functions and low practicability. In view of the above problems, combined with the smart home system, this paper studies and designs a smart nightstand with HT66F2390 microcontroller as the core. To save the bedroom space, other furniture functions are integrated, such as adaptive adjustment of night light and brightness, refrigeration and fresh-keeping, heating and insulation, drawer fingerprint unlock, LED light group changing in different occasions. LCD displays the user interface for easy operation. The smart nightstand is set up to test the environment and optimize the functions of each module. The results show that the designed intelligent bedside table can integrate the functions of other furniture. It effectively saves bedroom space and optimizes living experience. The expected design goal has been achieved.

articleTitle: Investigation and research countermeasures of students' subjectivity in mathematics classroom teaching in junior middle school
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Our country makes great efforts to develop quality education, in which the cultivation of students' subjectivity is the key. This paper studies the present situation of students' subjectivity in junior middle school mathematics class, finds out students' problems in learning mathematics, and puts forward some countermeasures to improve the teaching and learning of mathematics. By using the method of SPSS investigation and analysis, this paper makes an overall analysis of students' subjectivity and analyzes their gender differences and their correlation with mathematics scores, and draws a conclusion that junior high school students' subjectivity is good and there is still room for improvement in mathematics class. There is no significant difference in students' gender, and there is a significant correlation between subjectivity and mathematics achievement. Finally, the paper puts forward the relevant strategies on how to cultivate the subjectivity of junior high school students, hoping to be of some help to teachers and students.

articleTitle: Constructing Curriculum System of Robot Engineering Major from Perspective of Robot-making
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The purpose of this study was to construct the curriculum system of robot engineering specialty from the perspective of robot-making. The construction of curriculum system is a difficult systematic work. To build a scientific and reasonable curriculum system requires not only a solid theoretical foundation, but also long-term practical verification. In this study, we analyze the basic knowledge elements required to make robots, firstly. Based on this, the construction of core curriculum system has been discussed. And both potential training directions and training objectives have been given. Using the employment rate of graduates, we compared the curriculum system with the traditional curriculum system. The results show that the employment rate of graduates has increased by about 8% after using the proposed curriculum system. Our research provides a reference for the construction of robot engineering talent training mode.

articleTitle: Coupled Local and Global Semantic Alignment for Image-Text Matching
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The regional features in the image tend to focus more on the foreground information of the image, and the global features in the image tend to focus more on the important background information in the image. How to effectively integrate the foreground information and background information in the image have become an urgent problem to be solved. To address the above issus, we propose a novel Coupled Local and Global Semantic Alignment network. First we propose global image features of images to preserve important background information in images. Second we extract regional image features to preserve fine-grained semantic information in images. Then we utilize the GRU network to extract features for each word in the text. We align image features and text features globally and locally to obtain global similarity and local similarity. We assign different similarity weights to the similarity matrix to aggregate the similarity matrix. Extensive experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on SVD SNR Estimation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) is an important indicator of communication quality and an indispensable priori information in the signal processing process. In this paper, the SNR estimation algorithms based on singular value decomposition (SVD) are analyzed from two different perspectives. They are the matrix construction method and SNR calculation characteristics. At the same time, the advantages and disadvantages of these different algorithms are discussed. The simulation models are established to explain the influence of two matrix construction methods on SNR estimation and the accuracy and robustness of four SNR estimation methods. The simulation results show that the performance of Hankel matrix is more stable and the ratio determination method is more accurate and with lower complexity.

articleTitle: Test Paper Generation Based on Improved Genetic Simulated Annealing Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the wide application of online examinations in colleges and universities, intelligent test paper generation technology has become a hot topic. In this paper, we propose an improved genetic simulated annealing algorithm (GSA) and apply it to the test paper generation process to improve the quality and speed of intelligent test paper generation. Firstly, we optimize the genetic operators in real number coding and introduce an adaptive adjustment strategy on the premise of maintaining individual diversity. Secondly, we apply simulated annealing to individuals of each generation. Finally, we conduct abundant experiments. The results show that the improved algorithm can promote the success rate of test paper generation and effectively enhance the quality of test paper.

articleTitle: Leveraging Logistic Regression in Development of a Parkinson’s Disease (PD) Kinematics-based Diagnostic Framework
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Parkinson’s Disease (PD) is a neurodegenerative movement disorder caused by reduced dopamine, dopaminergic neurons, and nerve cells in the substantia nigra. Diagnosis of PD today largely clinical and relies on the Unified Parkinson’s Disease Rating Scale (MDS-UPDRS, also referred to as UPDRS), wherein clinicians observe gait patterns in patients and provide a subjective score ranging from 0-4 based on the ability of the patient to ambulate with out without aid. Diagnosis of PD is also complicated by 1) a lack of distinguishability from other gait and neurodegenerative disorders, including essential tremor (ET) and 2) increasing ambiguity of PD symptoms including gait deterioration and falls further from the onset of the condition. However, early PD diagnosis is imperative for patients to respond appropriately to intervention and relieve motor symptoms such as tremor and rigidity. This study aims to develop a gait-based diagnostic framework for PD using data collected at the University of Minnesota from healthy controls and PD patients over 3 years. The model was developed using R’s ggplot for feature selection and generalized linear model library (GLM) for logistic regression. The final metrics, including accuracy, standard error, and p-values, displayed the value in applying gait variables, such as cadence, in diagnostic models of PD. Such findings may offer potential future directives for the classification of PD from other tremor-related and neurodegenerative disorders such as multiple sclerosis, as well as exhaustive diagnosis of stages of PD based on the presence of motor symptoms, applying the H&Y scale.

articleTitle: A Binary Hybrid Grey Wolf Optimizer for MEC Offloading
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Resource allocation plays an important role in mobile edge computing (MEC) networks. However, the optimization of resource allocation is a mixed-integer non-linear programming (MINLP) problem. Due to its NP-hard characterization and shortcomings of traditional methods, solving such kind of problem is challenging. The original grey wolf optimizer (GWO) combined with particle swarm optimization (PSO) is appropriate for continuous problem but limited to the binary problem. The proposed BHGWO algorithm effectively combines the advantages of binary version of the PSO algorithm and GWO algorithm, and improves the optimization efficiency while maintaining the accuracy. Furthermore, a penalty method is introduced to the algorithm. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed algorithm can achieve better performance for MEC computation offloading in terms of system overhead and system utility.

articleTitle: Joint Learning of Similarity Graph and Low-rank Tensor for Multi-view Clustering
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Multi-view clustering methods have drawn more and more interest in recent years with the increase of unlabeled multi-view data. In order to make full use of the consistent and complementary information of multi-view data, and reduce the influence of noise and outlier, a similarity graph and low-rank tensor joint learning method (SGLTL) is proposed. SGLTL first obtains the similarity matrix of each view through the least-square regression method to pursue the low-order correlation. Then, the similarity matrices are integrated into a tensor with low-rank constraints to capture the high-order correlation. Finally, the similarity matrices and low-rank tensor are jointly learned to fully exploit the multi-view information and effectively remove noise and outliers. Experimental results on different benchmark datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Fast Classification of Alzheimer's Disease Based on Improved Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to apply an improved convolutional neural network to classify magnetic resonance images and predict the degree of Alzheimer's disease. Currently, tens of millions of people worldwide suffer from Alzheimer's disease, which greatly increases the cost to society. Early detection facilitates prompt treatment. Traditional diagnosis includes neuropsychological tests, hematological tests and neuroimaging tests. Due to the complexity, subjectivity, instability and other factors of manual inspection, the diagnosis may be wrong. Therefore, it is necessary to develop an objective, stable and automatic auxiliary diagnosis method. Since magnetic resonance images are unique and easy to obtain, they are very helpful for diagnosis. Therefore, this paper proposes a magnetic resonance image detection technology based on computer vision. Convolutional neural network has an outstanding performance in the field of image recognition and classification. Based on the improved convolutional neural network, the final training accuracy reaches 100%, and the test accuracy exceeds 99.7%, which can meet the needs of auxiliary diagnosis.

articleTitle: Deblurred Adversarial Defence For Object Tracking
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: It has become a consensus that deep convolutional neural network has poor resistance to attack. Blur attack is a usual attack method. Motion blur caused by fast moving is an important challenge in object tracking, which has a serious impact on the robustness and accuracy of tracking. The adversarial attack variant uses the generation principle of motion blur to attack a tracker leading to drift in the tracking process. In our work, a novel method is proposed to separate the input images after the tracker is attacked to obtain the target object and the background, which decomposes object positions and appearances in multiple consecutive sub-frames, and sharpens the appearances in the process. Then the target is embedded in the background, and the most appropriate result is selected as the new input to ensure the performance of the tracker. A self-supervised loss function is designed to improve the tracking performance and has a good generalization. After testing our algorithm on datasets, the experimental results prove that the proposed adversarial defense method plays a significant role in protecting the tracker after being attacked.

articleTitle: A Network Combining CNN and Transformer for Blind Image Super-Resolution
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Blind super-resolution (SR) requires not only estimating blur kernel, but also super-resolving low-resolution image based on estimated blur kernel. Most blind SR methods use convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for kernel estimation, which cannot exploit long-range dependency within image domain, thus failing to predict blur kernel accurately. To address this issue, we propose a network combining CNN and transformer named NCCT for kernel estimation. By modeling local and non-local image priors simultaneously, NCCT outperforms other blind SR methods in terms of kernel estimation accuracy. Moreover, we design a network module named RRFDB for constructing lightweight blind SR network, which runs faster and achieves comparative SR performance with fewer parameters compared with other state-of-the-art blind SR methods.

articleTitle: A homozygote for rs12709426 of the ACE gene in patients with essential hypertension: a case report
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objectives: As a polygenic disease, the pathogenesis of essential hypertension (EH) remains under investigation. We explored the association between EH and a single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) of ACE (rs12709426) in patients in the Hefei region of Anhui, China.Methods: Patients (n=400) with EH and 100 healthy cases as the control group were included. The SNP rs12709426 was detected using the improved multiple ligase detection reaction (imLDR) system. We designed a questionnaire to collect the general data of the patients.Results: The SNP rs12709426 only has a homozygous AA genotype, no gene polymorphism. There were no differences in the frequency of genetic polymorphism between the EH and control groups.Conclusion: The ACE gene SNP rs12709426 only has a homozygous AA genotype, and does not show an association with EH. There was no case report of homozygous ACE gene rs12709426 yet. The experiment provides a meaningful clue for further study on the susceptibility differences and pathogenesis of EH in different regions.

articleTitle: Retinal Vessel Segmentation Based on UNet and Edge Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Retinal vessel segmentation is important for the diagnosis of many diseases. The segmentation of microscopic vessels is one of the challenges because of the complex structure of retinal vessels, which makes it challenging to tell the vessels apart from the background. In order to improve the segmentation performance of retinal vessels, we use the edge detection method of HED to optimize the segmentation effect of UNet. Using Hybrid Dilated Convolution not only increases the perceptual field, but also avoids the loss of information continuity caused by the continuous use of dilated convolution. The Pyramid Pooling Module is used at the end of the encoder to compensate for the information loss caused by downsampling. Finally, the output of edge detection and image segmentation is combined as the final result. The model is evaluated in two mainstream datasets DRIVE and CHASE_DB1, and the experimental results show that the proposed model can improve the performance of retinal vessel segmentation.

articleTitle: A TCM Disease Retrieval Method Based on Weighted Word Vector
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: TCM intelligent diagnosis algorithm is of great significance to promote the standardization, intelligence and popularization of TCM consultation. Disease diagnosis task is the key link of TCM intelligent diagnosis algorithm. In recent years, word vector models have been applied to disease diagnosis tasks. However, it is difficult to use the word vector model for disease diagnosis alone to meet the requirements of accuracy. In order to improve this situation, this paper transforms the problem of disease diagnosis into a disease retrieval problem, and designs and implements a TCM disease retrieval method based on weighted word vectors. The method retrieves the patient’s symptoms collected by the TCM intelligent diagnosis algorithm in the TCM disease database, and finally retrieves the disease that best matches the patient’s symptoms as the disease diagnosis result. The experimental results show that the method has a good effect on the task of disease diagnosis, and can provide a new idea for the realization of the task of disease diagnosis.

articleTitle: The Influencing Factors of Learning Satisfaction in Blended Learning during Covid-19 in Chinese medical universities
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: By using a technology acceptance model (TAM) on survey results collected from medical universities of China, this paper aims to uncover the major factors that affect medical students’ acceptance of blended learning during the Covid-19 period. 1238 medical students completed the study survey after experiencing 3 months of blended learning. The results show that the social influence (SIN) and perceived ease of use (PEOU) have positive impacts on perceived usefulness (PU); PU has positive impacts on learning motivation (LM); LM can moderately affect learning satisfaction (LS). There is also a positive relationship between SIN and LS. It is worth noting that SIN as an intermediary factor directly affects PEOU, PU and LS. In fact, SIN is considered the key factor that affect student satisfaction of blended learning during Covid-19.

articleTitle: Online EEG Classification of Meditative States for Wearable Devices using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Wearable devices with EEG acquisition have been used to provide or assist meditative interventions. This paper presents a simulation scheme for wearable EEG devices for real time detection of mental states. Relative spectra and derived rhythm energies were used for classification features. Four machine learning algorithms, LDA, Bayes, SVM and KNN were applied to test 10 subjects who were instructed to perform 40 min focus-meditation. Offline training and testing were investigated to optimize the parameters of the classifiers, which yield an efficient computation method for the online model. The results demonstrate that the online detection pipeline is viable in real-time applications of wearable EEG devices.

articleTitle: Improving Emotion Classification by a Combination of Personal Texts and Social Big Data Based on Naive Bayes
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Nowadays, a lot of personal texts are available due to the rise of social networking platforms. Using the texts, many research are conducted to estimate emotions. Especially, the tweets posted on Twitter are used in research employing machine learning as a training data for emotion analysis and classification. In the classification, it may be possible to improve the accuracy by using one’s own past texts as a training data. In this study, we combine personal texts and Twitter data as the training data and try to improve the accuracy of emotion estimation by using Naive Bayes. We obtain texts from one’s past diary. In addition, tweets are collected from similar attributes accounts. By an evaluator, the texts and tweets are classified into three categories: positive, negative, and neutral. Then, we set four patterns by changing the combination of personal texts and tweets. As a result, the highest average accuracy was obtained by weighting words that appeared in personal texts and combining them with Twitter data. It shows that it is important to focus on words that the person has used in the past in estimating his/her own emotions.

articleTitle: The Application of GSP in Junior Middle School Mathematics —— take the Suke version textbook as an example
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the help of teaching examples, this paper compares GSP with traditional teaching tools to highlight their advantages and value in mathematics teaching. Through exploring the dynamic problems of angles in the seventh grade book of Suke Edition, comparative analysis, showing the unique advantages of geometric drawing boards in simply visualizing complex problems, combining teaching practices, summarizing teaching strategies, providing teaching help and guidance for front-line teachers, and improving classroom teaching efficiency.

articleTitle: A modified artifact subspace rejection algorithm based on frequency properties for meditation detection application
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) signals provide insights with human brain states such as brain focusing (BF) states and mind wandering (MF) states in contemplative practice such as meditation. Recently, wearable EEG devices have been developed to detect and facilitate such kind exercises. However, wearable EEG devices with limited computing resources suffer from issues like artifacts and noises even more than traditional ones. Succinct and effective algorithms are critical for online detection of mind states with wearable devices. This study proposes a modified scheme of artifact subspace reconstruction (ASR) in frequency domain suitable for multi-channel EEG meditation detection, allowing a consistent property in the preprocessing calculation, which makes online detection of mind states feasible with wearable EEG devices.

articleTitle: Detection of Abnormal Crowd Behavior Based on Graph Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the increasing demand for public safety precautions, the accuracy and timeliness of abnormal crowd behavior detection is gradually improving. Therefore, with the development of the technology for the abnormal crowd behavior, it’s even more demanding on how to effectively prevent the occurrence of accidents and eliminate the impact of disasters on the society. This article first introduces the current applications of abnormal behavior detection and the research and development of related technologies. Second, it proposes a method for detecting abnormal crowd behavior based on Graph Convolutional Neural Network (GCN). This method first proposes to effectively and accurately locate the abnormal behavior characteristics through the extraction of abnormal behavior characteristics from the auto-encoder of the surveillance video. With the construction of the graph classification model based on SAGPool, the classification of normal and abnormal behavior is carried out. Finally, experimental data show that data displayed with this method meet the expected requirements.

Author Keywords: based on Graph Convolutional Neural Network (GCN)

articleTitle: A Skip Residual Features Aggregation-Based Methodology for Classification of 3D Lung Nodules
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)v
abstract: Lung cancer is one of the deadliest diseases caused by genetic and textural mutations leading to infinite proliferation of tissue cells, which can be diagnosed and prevented in advance by medical images, and deep learning provides an effective automatic diagnosis technique for this purpose. However, the diagnostic accuracy as well as the reduction of fault-diagnosis and misdiagnosis rates still need to be improved. To address this problem, a skip residual features aggregation-based methodology for classification of 3D Lung nodules is proposed. Through two pathways, residual fusion and dimensional stitching of features are achieved to improve the richness of deep feature information, suppress network degradation, and maintain feature continuity. Before training, the images are pre-processed with ROI region extraction, setting of window width window level, voxel normalization and data augmentation. Finally, the average precision in benign and malignant classification task is 86%, the recall reaches 87%, and the f1-score is 86%. The average precision in texture type of classification is 82%, the recall is 83%, and the f1-score is 82%.

articleTitle: Insulator Defect Detection Based on YOLOv4-tiny with Improved Feature Fusion
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Insulator exposed to a wild environment for long-term running usually suffers from the damage of natural calamities that makes them become one of the most fragile components in the whole power system. In this case, even a slight fault will seriously affect the power supply safety of the power grid. Therefore, it is critical to find and identify the faulty insulator efficiently and accurately. However, an insulator is quite a small component in comparison with a huge power system which makes it hard to visible with naked eyes. This characteristic leads to poor recognition accuracy for existing detection methods. In order to solve the above problems, we propose an insulator defect detection algorithm based on an improved YOLOv4-tiny model. It differs from existing insulator detection models, our algorithm applies the effective channel attention network to the feature extraction network of YOLOv4-tiny, which significantly enhances the feature extraction ability of the backbone network. These two-way features of the pyramid can be fully fused in the two-way feature fusion stages seamlessly. Experimental results show that compared with, our proposed algorithm outperforms Faster RCNN and YOLOv3 in average classification accuracy, missed detection, and false detection.

articleTitle: Literature analysis of the effect of Huanglian Wendan Decoction on anxiety and depression
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)v
abstract: Objective: To analyze the effect of Huanglian Wendan decoction on anxiety and depression. Methods: Inpatients with anxiety syndrome caused by different causes REPORTED in different literatures, the efficacy of taking Huanglian Wendan decoction was compared with that of patients without taking Huanglian Wendan decoction. Results: After the application of Huanglian Wendan decoction, the remission rate was significantly improved, and the difference was statistically significant. Conclusion: Huanglian Wendan Decoction has obvious effect on the improvement of anxiety and depression.

articleTitle: Efficacy and safety of acupuncture for cervicogenic insomnia: A protocol for a systematic review and meta-analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Introduction: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the efficacy and safety of acupuncture on cervicogenic insomnia. Methods and analysis: We will search from the following databases, PubMed, the Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials, EMBASE, Web of Science, Chinese BioMedical Literature Database (CBM), China National Knowledge Infrastructure (CNKI), Wan Fang Data and VIP Database for Chinese Technical Periodicals (CQVIP). We selected the eligible studies published up to July 2022. All randomised controlled trials related to acupuncture for cervicogenic insomnia will be included. The main outcomes include the total effective rate, Pittsburgh sleep index(PSQI). The secondary outcomes include self-rating scale of sleep (SRSS), Neck Pain Questionnaire(NPQ) and adverse events or reactions. RevMan 5.3 statistical software will be used for meta-analysis, and the level of evidence will be assessed by Grading of Recommendations Assessment, Development, and Evaluation. Conclusion: The systematic review will provide a basis for evaluating the efficacy and safety of acupuncture in the treatment of cervicogenic insomnia.

articleTitle: Analysis of 5G+ Internet of Vehicles Application Based on SPN
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: SPN is an innovative technology system proposed for 5G transmission. SPN can realize comprehensive service transmission with large bandwidth, low delay and high efficiency in Internet of Vehicles, but there are still problems to be resolved. In this paper, the slicing function and service carrying capacity of SPN system are analyzed by constructing SPN test network. The test data show that the management and control planes of the slice function can greatly reduce the complexity of service opening and maintenance, and the forwarding plane can realize the function of isolation and flexible bandwidth scheduling of the IoV service based on FlexE technology, and the combination of service bearing and Service Router can effectively reduce the risk of service interruption and improve the network security performance.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Remote Control Car Based on MCU
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)v
abstract: With the development of economy and society, intelligence has become more and more popular, and intelligent remote control car plays an increasingly important role in all walks of life. In order to promote the application of intelligent car and improve the automation level of unmanned transportation, this paper designs an intelligent remote control car based on STC89C52 micro-controller, which is composed of remote control module and car module. There are two selection modes in the remote control module: body mode (the purpose of controlling the movement of the car is achieved by tilting the remote control from front to back, left to right by the user) and remote sensing module (the purpose of controlling the movement of the car is achieved by the user by operating the two axis key rocker sensor on the remote control), which enables the car to make left turns, right turns, forward turns, backward turns, accelerates and decelerates according to the user’s requirements. Based on the technology of wireless communication and radio remote control, this paper focuses on the practical application design of wireless communication in life. Its design idea can be applied in transportation, production and other fields, and has a high market application value.

Author Keywords: Remote control based on Body feeling

articleTitle: An End-to-end Foreground Category Attention Boosting Network
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In this paper, we introduce a foreground category attention boosting (CAB) framework for coarse-to-fine image segmentation, which makes full use of the coarse category information in low resolution layers. Our contributions can be summarized as: Firstly, we introduce the category attention mechanism to build the CAB module, which realizes a new stronger learner by aggregating the coarse category information and the feature maps of the current layer. Secondly, we propose an end-to-end foreground category attention boosting (FAB) neural network, which fully utilizes the complementary effects among different resolution feature maps and enhances the contribution from low resolution layers to fine segmentation with low computational cost. Thirdly, Extensive experiments on public dataset show that our approach can achieve superior performance over the state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: Design of intelligent diffraction light intensity measuring instrument based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to realize the automation of diffraction experiments, reduce the experimental errors caused by manual operation, and realize the function of remote detection of diffraction light intensity using the Internet of things. The design uses the STC89C52 chip as the main control chip to drive the stepping motor and read the data of the light intensity detection module; Using esp8266 as the core chip to realize the functions of the Internet of things. It can accept the instructions sent by the mobile app through the MQTT protocol, transmit the instructions to the main control chip, and upload the data collected by the main control chip to the server. The MQTT server adopted in this design is built by Raspberry Pi. It can process and draw data while realizing data transfer. Users can receive these data and pictures with mobile phones. This instrument not only has small error and high precision but also can make the light intensity distribution of single slit diffraction fringe more intuitively.

articleTitle: Few-shot handwritten Chinese character generation based on generative adversarial network
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Chinese characters are different from the English alphabet that English consists of 26 simple words, whereas Chinese characters contain multiple strokes, complex structures and a variety of styles, which makes the study of Chinese character style transfer a challenging problem. In recent years, generative adversarial networks have been used to automatically generate handwritten Chinese characters, but these methods often produce Chinese characters with a variety of stroke errors, such as multiple strokes and missing strokes. Especially, few works focus on the problem of few-shot handwritten Chinese character generation. A further problem that is worth exploring is that in practice, people often want to use only a small number of handwritten Chinese characters, then let the model automatically generate a large number of handwritten Chinese characters with the same style. Therefore, in this paper, few-shot handwritten Chinese character generation is discussed in detail. The experimental results show that it is possible to use only a few tens of handwritten characters to automatically generate a library of handwritten characters with special style.

articleTitle: Research On Correlation Between Higher Education Investment, Scientific And Technological Innovation And Economic Growth In Shandong Province Under The Background Of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This paper mainly studies the correlation between higher education investment, scientific and technological innovation and economic growth in Shandong Province under the background of big data. Firstly, the vector autoregressive (VAR) model is constructed, and the ADF unit root test and Johansen co-integration test are carried out to empirically analyze the long-term dynamic equilibrium relationship between higher education investment, scientific and technological innovation and the healthy growth of national economy in Shandong Province. The results show that there is a long-term dynamic and balanced relationship among higher education expenditure investment, human capital investment, scientific and technological innovation and the healthy growth of national economy in Shandong Province. Then according to the analysis results, some suggestions are put forward for the development of higher education construction in Shandong Province. Shandong Province should continue to increase the investment in higher education, strengthen the construction of high-level disciplines in colleges and universities in Shandong Province, transform the investment in higher education into high-level talents and scientific research achievements, and then improve social productivity, so as to promote economic growth.

articleTitle: Research on Lateral Impact Resistance of Concrete Filled Steel Tubular Columns
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The dynamic response of concrete filled steel tubular composite columns subjected to impact is a complex nonlinear process. In this paper, the finite element model of the steel frame is established by using the ABAQUS explicit dynamic analysis module. The impact velocity, the impact position and the impact quality of the impact block on the dynamic response of the composite column under impact are studied by the parametric analysis method. The results show that the results of numerical simulation are consistent with the law of conservation of energy for steel frame columns under impact, and the results are reliable. The displacement response of the column increases with the increase of the impact mass, and the displacement response of the column increases with the increase of the impact velocity, and the displacement response of the column increases with the decrease of the boundary constraint.

articleTitle: A Study on Sentiment Analysis of Online Course Review Information Based on XLNet-BiGRU
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Texts from course comments play a crucial role in the online learning environment on the Internet. In a positive way, the sentiment data contributes significantly to classroom engagement, enhances the effectiveness of instruction, and fosters the long-term growth of online courses. How to effectively assess the emotional qualities of Chinese course review information and adjust the course quality properly is one of the hot topics of the current study. In this study, we propose a sentiment analysis model based on XLNet-BiGRU for categorizing the sentiment polarity of course review text in Chinese online courses. First, the text corpus data is learned using the XLNet pre-training model. The major sentiment characteristics and contextual features are then extracted from the comments using the BiGRU model, and the attention mechanism is used as a weighting method to increase the weight of the sentiment words in the sentences. The Softmax layer ultimately classifies the weighted features. According to the experimental findings, the XLNet-BiGRU model, which incorporates the BiGRU model, can fully extract the text’s deep semantic information and, to a certain extent, increase the task’s effectiveness in classifying sentiments.

articleTitle: A Channel-level Neural Network Compression Method Based on K-order Statistics
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: At present, deep neural networks (DNNs) have been widely used, and the deployment of DNNs to resource-constrained devices becomes a popular trend, which leads to the problem of compression of deep neural networks. In this paper, we propose a channel-level deep neural network compression method, which aims to remove unimportant channels in the network, reduce the number of neural network parameters, and improve the performance of the compressed neural network. Specifically, to reduce channel redundancy more effectively, our approach introduces K-order statistics in the Batch Normalization (BN) layer, identifies and removes channels with low statistical values to generate a compact network, and improves the accuracy of the compressed network by fine-tuning. Our approach does not change the DNN architecture and does not require special hardware and software accelerators for the generated compression network. Our method was tested on CIFAR-10 image classification public dataset with various DNN models. By comparing with other model compression methods, the effectiveness of our method has been demonstrated.

articleTitle: A Framework for simulation control Systems Based on Software Product Line
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: At present, the fast-changing functional requirements of simulation control system in Aerospace and navigation, where various hardware boards are used, have caused the high complexity and long development cycle of control systems. Although such systems have a certain degree of similarity, they are not well reused. In order to solve these problems, this paper puts forward the idea of using the software product line to model the control system of spacecraft and designs a framework. Using this framework, a simulation wave data acquisition software is developed. The application of this framework can achieve maximum granularity of software reuse, and improve the development efficiency.

articleTitle: Network configuration approach based on the reliability service
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Wireless communication network plays an important role in various industries. One of the key concern in wireless communication is network security. This paper proposes an optimal transmission lines assignment with maximal reliabilities in the wireless communication. Firstly, a reliability evaluation metric with a transmission line assignment is proposed for calculating the reliability service under some constraints.
