Secondly, based on the reliability, non-dominated sorting Genetic algorithm is used for working out the optimal solution via considering the network security. Some simulated experiments are conducted that the proposed approach is able to obtain the reasonable solution under the time constraints.

articleTitle: Design and practice of "Internet +" blended teaching
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The advent of the "Internet +" era has made profound changes in the field of education. With the development of education informationzation, various teaching platforms and mobile terminals are timely, providing technical support for the transformation from traditional teaching to Blended teaching. This paper takes ketang-pai as the tool of intelligent teaching, takes financial marketing course as an example, studies the new mode of hybrid teaching, and puts forward suggestions to optimize the teaching effect based on practice.

articleTitle: An Enhanced Convolution Neural Network Model based on Depthwise-separable Convolutions for Pneumonia Classification
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This paper is an attempt to customize a lightweight model to classify pneumonia images by integrating depthwise-separable convolutions with typical CNN model, and focus on the performance of DSCNN in comparison with typical CNN model based on X-ray images. The experimental result shows that in our four-layer structure, DSCNN reduce around 50,000 parameters compared to CNN. But DSCNN had a relative low recall on COVID-19(89.23%). However, with proper means of optimization such as focal loss and data augmentation, there was a slight increase in test accuracy of DSCNN(from 95.25% to 96.14%), and a significant increase in recall on COVID-19(from 89.23% to 94.61%). And this model also performed well on the rest two labels.

articleTitle: Escalator passenger posture anomaly detection based on improved SSD model
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the widespread use of escalators in daily life, escalator-related injury factors are threatening public health. To secure escalator system, most of existing studies focus on post hoc statistics and trend to fix these deficiencies to reduce escalator-related potential risks. However, they are not designed for early-stage detection of impending escalator unsafe factors. To solve this problem, this paper proposes an improved Single Shot MultiBox Detector (SSD) algorithm for anomaly detection of passenger posture on escalators. Firstly, we replace the widely used VGG16 backbone of SSD network by simpler MobileNetV2 to accelerate model inference. Secondly, the distance intersection over Union (DIoU) loss function is introduced to further improve performance. Based on the characteristics of IoU and considering the shortcomings of GIoU, DIoU directly regresses the Euclidean distance between the center points of the two boxes to accelerate the convergence. The experimental results show that the improved SSD escalator passenger posture anomaly detection algorithm can efficiently identify the dangerous posture of escalator passengers and start relevant safety protection measures. According to inference of model, the escalator system can be controlled in practice to formulate the corresponding safety protection measures, and improve the safety performance of the escalator operation.

articleTitle: A GAN Based Heart Sound Denoising Model
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The current mainstream methods of heart sound denoising are susceptible to human subjectivity and leads to distortion of the heart sound signal after denoising. In this paper, a generative adversarial network (GAN) based model is proposed to denoise the heart sound signal. It learns the deep features of heart sound signals by building a deep neural network. Both clean heart sound signal and the noisy are fed into the generator in parallel during the training phase and the relevant loss function is introduced. This enables the network to better learn the feature information in the clean heart sound signal, which has been shown to increase the average signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) by about 1 dB. We use SNR, root mean square error (RMSE) and percent root mean square difference (PRD) as metrics. Then the proposed model was compared with denoising models based on wavelet transform (WT) and empirical modal decomposition (EMD). Experiments show that the method we proposed has a high overall SNR and low RMSE and PRD.

articleTitle: Personalized Custom Virtual Fitting Display Method
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the maturity of 3D and AR technologies, many e-commerce platforms have launched the function of virtual fitting rooms. Although it attracted a lot of attention, the real experience is not good. At present, the main problems of many virtual fitting platforms are inaccurate in clothing version and size, and the dressing effect is quite different. Therefore, the virtual fitting platform to customize personalized clothing has potential application value. In this study, we consider trying on different clothing on a detailed 3D mannequin to increase the experience. First, a human body database is established, and then the fine faces are obtained according to the 3D face scanning technology. According to the synthesis technology of human body and human face, a virtual human body with fine facial features is obtained. Finally, the different fabrics clothes can try on the virtual body to show the effect. The experimental results show that this method can quickly try on clothes of different fabrics to complete personalized customization.

articleTitle: Teaching Practice of "SPOC College" –A Case Study of "Data Visualization Technology" course
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the popularity of big data technology, people's life is increasingly inseparable from network equipment, information acquisition gradually presents the characteristics of fragmentation, and it is difficult to effectively manage resources systematically. Based on this, Firstly, this paper investigates the powerful resource carrier SPOC teaching platform and defines the framework of online resource construction. And then, Take the course "Data Visualization Technology" as an example to develop the design, The modules of teaching resources construction, teaching process practice and teaching evaluation are realized. In the end, from two aspects of quantitative analysis and qualitative analysis, the superiority of SPOC College as a new teaching experience platform is verified from multiple perspectives, which can effectively improve the quality of education and teaching.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Legal Issues in Medical Informatics Abroad and in China
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Research Purpose This article aims at understanding the important laws and regulations in medical informatics in order to improve the awareness of medical informatics professionals on the risks associated with the use of information, and ensure the implementation of the latest laws, regulations and related policies. Proposed Methods This article will describe and analyse the legal issues in Medical Informatics both abroad and in China. Results The relevant laws and regulations of typical foreign countries help protect health records and data in research. In China, the research on the legal issues of medical informatics on data sharing is lacking. China has not yet completed its personal information protection legal system, the current privacy protection system is insufficient. Conclusion The highest priority of the health information management team must be patient safety. Understanding the important laws and regulations in medical informatics is essential for researchers and practitioners in the discipline to establish standardized research and operations.

articleTitle: Design of a Distributed Collaborative Chinese Medicine Treatment Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: As an important traditional culture in China, Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) not only represents the characteristics of Chinese medical science, but also highlights the advantages of independent innovation. In recent years, the rapid growth of TCM medical record data has accelerated the digitalization and informatization of medical information. The traditional Chinese medicine diagnosis and treatment platform is often trapped in the dilemma of high data reading and storage delay and inability to effectively visualize the data in big data processing, and its computing efficiency and system practicability cannot be significantly improved. A distributed collaborative Chinese medicine diagnosis and treatment platform is proposed in this paper, which is controlled by the STM32F407 series microcontroller, supplemented by ADS1292 module to measure ECG signal and TFTLCD LCD display. In the platform, the data is transmitted to the system server through WIFI module, and the MySQL technology combined with java is used to develop the system web side. The doctor can consult with the patient face to face and view the patient’s condition in real time through the web terminal. The collected ECG signal is displayed on the consultation interface through the pulse rate and the recovered pulse rate graph. Through the measurement of the module and the interaction on the web side, this paper can better simulate the "look", "smell", "ask" and "cut" way of diagnosis and treatment. The paper is able to simulate the "look", "smell", "ask" and "cut" methods of diagnosis and treatment, and realise remote Chinese medicine diagnosis and treatment.

articleTitle: Teaching resource recommendation for OBE based on kernel canonical correlation analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)v
abstract: Data mining is used to extract information from OBE teaching resources, then the teaching resources and user personality database are established to improve the effectiveness of resources recommendation on the online learning platform. The properties of teaching resources and user personality traits are analyzed using the kernel canonical correlation analysis algorithm, and teaching materials with a high correlation coefficient are chosen to recommend to users. The simulation results demonstrate that this proposed method has higher accuracy and more accurate recommended resources when compared to the widely used teaching resource recommendation techniques.

articleTitle: ResGER: Resnet-based Group Emotion Recognition for Crowd Evacuation
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Emotion plays a vital role in crowd evacuation, e.g., the excessive panic emotion leads to pushing and stampede and thus causing heavy loss of life and property. Group emotion recognition can identify the emotions of the crowd and provide effective guidance for the emotional contagion of the crowd evacuation. However, the existing crowd emotional contagion models are mainly designed based on random initial conditions and specific hypothetical conditions, and cannot be applied to the actual crowd evacuation guidance. Deep learning based group emotion recognition is an efficient method which can capture real time features of crowd emotions from videos and apply them to the emotional contagion of the crowd evacuation. In this paper, we propose a resnet-based group emotion recognition (ResGER) method for crowd evacuation. This method is generally divided into three steps: The first step is to extract the expression features of each face obtained in the scene through the existing expression recognition network. The second step is to train a network that scores the importance of these characteristics. The third step is to fuse the feature vectors and output the classification results according to the results of the first two steps. Experimental results show that our method is effective and can provide great support for the practical emotional contagion simulation of crowd evacuation.

articleTitle: Online Teaching Practice of Computer Network Course
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Due to the impact of the COVID-19, online teaching has become a common teaching method at present, and in-depth research on online teaching methods is of great practical significance. In the computer network course, we organize the online teaching process according to the BOPPPS model combined with online teaching tools such as DingTalk and Rain Classroom. We use Rain Classroom to seize the pre-class preview and use DingTalk to achieve participatory online interactive teaching and complete homework correction and online Q&A. The results of the questionnaire show that the above-mentioned teaching organization method can enable students to actively participate in interactive teaching, and students' approval of online teaching is relatively high.

articleTitle: Dynamic Adjustment of Packet Based on Fair Bandwidth Allocation in IEEE 802.11 Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In view of the imbalance of upstream and downstream flows in the access of local manufacturing resources, this paper proposes a dynamic adjustment algorithm based on bandwidth fair allocation (DAPFBA, Dynamic Adjustment of Packet based on Fair Bandwidth Allocation), which dynamically adjusts the packet size of nodes according to the number of downflows and realizes the downstream throughput balance, so as to realize the fair distribution of upstream and downstream bandwidth. According to the actual situation of the network, the algorithm can be implemented in the AP without modifying the MAC of other wireless nodes, which saves the workload of the implementation. Especially in the case of more and scattered wireless nodes, it only needs to modify the AP without modifying other nodes, eliminating a lot of work to configure the decentralized nodes.

articleTitle: E-Learning Design for Psychologists to Implement Chatbots for Clients with Borderline Personality Disorder
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Individuals who meet the criteria for disorders must therefore be assisted in order to maintain their mental health. Borderline personality disorder (BPD) is a personality disorder that can be present in many cultures. This research has a target to design e-learning for psychologist for implementing the chatbot for clients with borderline personality. Since everything can now be done using the internet, psychologists can learn how to counsel clients with BPD using e-learning. The study employed the observation, interview, and focus group discussion methods (FGD). Observations and interviews with psychologists were conducted during the diagnosis and counseling process. A focus group discussion (FGD) with seven participants who scored above 70 on the BPD-scale was held in order to implement a chatbot for clients with BPD. After compiling the questions and answers, a chatbot is created for clients with BPD to use. Three psychologists reported that the chatbot assisted them since when they did not meet with the psychologist, BPD clients could communicate with the chatbot. E-learning designed for psychologists to implement chatbots for clients with borderline personality disorder can help psychologists assist BPD clients more easily.

articleTitle: Construction and Application of Software Organization Asset Library Based on GJB5000B
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The military software capability maturity model is a set of best practices of the whole life cycle process technology and management of military software. GJB5000B level 3 emphasizes the establishment and use of reusable assets for the organization, which is a summary of the best practices of most military-industrial units. Through the mutual iteration of the establishment and maintenance of the process asset library and the operation of the project-level system, it accumulates and excavates continuously in the project technology and management process, and extracts the effective information from the massive knowledge base, to continuously enrich the organizational process library, to promote the continuous improvement of organizational capacity. By using these assets in the project, the sustainable accumulation of organizational assets can be realized and the process performance of the project can be improved.

articleTitle: Sequence generation model of traditional Chinese medicine
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The application of artificial intelligence in the field of traditional Chinese medicine is more and more extensive, and the related research is also more and more. Increasingly, the electronic processing of TCM textual information is becoming more and more important. In this paper, we propose a TCM text-based prescription generation task, intending to be able to implement automatic prescription generation functions based on the sequence-to-sequence (seq2seq) model. Traditional TCM prescriptions are given by the attending physicians, and the prescription recommendation system proposed in this paper achieves a certain degree of accuracy compared to real doctors. After a series of system data training, we improved the accuracy rate to 76%. For FI the value reached the best result of 74% at the existing stage.

articleTitle: Application of Mixed Reality Object Recognition Technology in Aircraft Maintenance Manual
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the gradual application of digital technology in the aviation maintenance industry, Mixed Reality (MR) technology, as an auxiliary technology, can combine equipment maintenance models, real world and relevant aircraft maintenance manuals. This can improve the efficiency of maintenance personnel, reduce maintenance errors and improve maintenance quality. In order to achieve an effective application of MR in the verification of electronic technical publications, a method is proposed which is based on the Vuforia SDK developed by Qualcomm for image matching for marker recognition and Mixed Reality Toolkit (MRTK) for functional interaction. The developed content can then be displayed through HoloLens glasses for mixed reality output. Finally, the developed content is experimented and verified through rectifier cone disassembly experiments. Combined with the case study it can be concluded that the method can be well applied to the validation process of electronic technical publications.

articleTitle: Exploration on the Cultivation System of Application-oriented Innovative Talents under the Internet+ Background
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: According to the expected learning achievements, we organize, implement and evaluate the education model, and improve the curriculum network resources under the help of the Internet in this paper. The integration of industry, scientific research and competition in classroom teaching was strengthend, and a cross-school and cross-industry network virtual teaching and research section was built. A number of reforms have taken effect and improved the existing training mode of innovative talents in colleges and universities, transforming from knowledge indoctrination to innovative ability training. With the long-term linkage of curriculum design, innovative projects, subject competitions and graduation designs as the link, a number of high-quality teachers and scientific research forces in colleges and universities were introduced, and cutting-edge industrial technologies were made full use to cultivate students’ innovative thinking. The development of innovative talent training system has achieved remarkable results. More and more students have taken part in in the competition, and the level of the reward and number of award-winning students are increasing year by year. The abilities of students can meet the qualified personnel demands of enterprises well.

articleTitle: Knowledge graph construction for computer networking course group in secondary vocational school based on multi-source heterogeneous data
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Computer science major in secondary vocational schools focuses on cultivating students' ability to solve complex engineering problems. Thus both theoretical and practical teaching of professional courses are critically important. Due to the rapid update of knowledge in the computer domain, it is becoming challenging to better integrate theory and practice knowledge for teaching with advanced intelligent information technology. This paper constructs the knowledge graph for the computer networking course group in secondary vocational schools. We first propose methods for data acquisition, keyword extraction, relationship extraction, and knowledge storage. Then, we describe the complete process for constructing the knowledge graph. Finally, we visualize the relationship between knowledge points for theoretical and practical courses with the tool SmartKG. Our proposed method provides new ideas for teaching computer courses in secondary vocational schools, which helps cultivate high-quality skilled talents.

articleTitle: A Single Photon Counting Ranging System Tolerating 100Klux Background light
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In this paper, a single photon ranging system is proposed and designed. The depth data processing and acquisition are completed on the SOC chip, and 60 × 1 dynamically adjustable SPAD array pixels are integrated. The histogram distribution of photon arrival time is realized based on TCSPC. The histogram algorithm is implemented in MCU firmware, which can resist outdoor strong light, the system is shown to work up to 100 Klux of background light with depth error lower than 15 mm at 1000 mm.

articleTitle: Research on the training mode of innovative and entrepreneurial talents in higher vocational colleges based on the integration of production and education under the normal state of epidemic prevention and control
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: At present, the entrepreneurship education of college students in my country still has the following pain points, such as the in-depth integration between production and teaching, the lack of effective integration of various educational resources to create a complete education security system and innovation and entrepreneurship system, the lack of a relatively complete talent training curriculum system, lack of Measures of the integration of production and education to comprehensively cultivate the ability of innovation and entrepreneurship of college students, etc. This paper proposes that by combining the characteristics of higher vocational colleges, deepening the integration of production and education, promoting innovation and entrepreneurship, and building a talent training model for innovation and entrepreneurship, the education chain, talent chain, industry chain and innovation chain can be organically connected. Practice has proved that all parties involved have achieved a win-win situation of co-construction and sharing.

articleTitle: Dual-Attention Feature Decoupling in Siamese Networks for Object Tracking
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Object tracking have been made significant progress in Siamese-based trackers, however, it is still difficult to track the target under scale variations, occlusions and unknown deformations. To solve this issue, we propose to decouple feature in tracking-heads by dual-attention to alleviate the conflict between the required features of classification and regression tasks. Specifically, we introduce channel attention to enhance high-level semantic feature for classification and adopt deformable attention to stress high-resolution local detail information for regression, separately. Besides, we propose multi-stage losses strategy to fuse multi-level features for effectively optimizing the classification and regression tasks after decoupling tracking-heads to improve tracking performance. Extensive experiments on visual tracking benchmarks including VOT2019 and OTB100, demonstrate that SiamDTH achieves state-of-the-art performance with a considerable real-time speed.

articleTitle: Multi-view Graph Convolution for Dialogue State Tracking
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Dialogue state tracking (DST) is a significant part of prevalent task-oriented dialogue systems, which monitors the user’s goals based on current and previous dialogues to achieve effective dialogue management. However, the information sharing among domain-specific slots is a main challenge in DST design, especially in terms of information interaction among domain-specific slots. To deal with this challenge, multi-view graph convolution is introduced in this paper to help DST models learn domain-specific associations among slots. A multi-view graph is presented to provide more associative information for the embedding of each domain-specific slot. Compared with a single-view graph, which can only learn global domain-specific slot associations, the multi-view one incorporates two additional graphs for learning similar and non-similar domain-specific slot associations, thus improving the inter-slot information sharing capability of DST models. Experiments results shows that the proposed method achieved a higher joint goal accuracy than that of existing state-of-the-art DST models.

articleTitle: Application of Tirofiban for Stent-Assisted Coiling in Acutely Ruptured Intracranial Aneurysms
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: To investigate the use of Tirofiban for stent-assisted coiling (SAC) in patients with acutely ruptured intracranial aneurysms (ARICA).Methods: The clinical data of 46 patients with a total of 47 intracranial aneurysms treated in with SAC within 72 hours after subarachnoid hemorrhage in the Department of Neurointervention, Tiantan Hospital, Capital Medical University from January 2015 to January 2019 were retrospectively analyzed. Since oral antiplatelet agents cannot be taken preoperatively, these patients were intravenously infused with tirofiban hydrochloride (10 μg/kg, completed within 3 min) before stent deployment, followed by 0.10 μg/kg/min via continuous intravenous pumping for 12 hours. Aspirin enteric-coated tablets (300 mg) and clopidogrel tablets (300mg) were given orally or nasal feeding 4 hours before the discontinuation of tirofiban. After 24 hours, aspirin enteric-coated tablets (100 mg) were given on a daily basis, in combination with oral clopidogrel tablets (75mg) for 2 months, and aspirin enteric-coated tablets were administered as a monotherapy for 4 months.Results: The perioperative complications included intraoperative aneurysm re-rupture (n=1), postoperative intracranial hemorrhage (n=1), stent thrombosis (n=2), and upper gastrointestinal bleeding (n=2). No urinary tract or intra-abdominal bleeding was observed. After the surgery, 20 patients underwent lumbar puncture or continued lumbar cerebrospinal fluid drainage and 4 patients received ventricular puncture and drainage. No thrombocytopenia was noted.Conclusions: In patients with ARICA who are not able to receive prompt dual antiplatelet therapy, tirofiban hydrochloride is an effective alternative that can be used during SAC for ARICA.

articleTitle: Study on the Influence of Second-order Effect on the Displacement of Steel Frames
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The stability analysis of steel structures is a common problem in engineering. For high-rise steel structures, the corresponding accuracy of first-order analysis and second-order analysis is different. The ABAQUS/CAE finite element software is used to establish a 10 story steel frame structure, and an irregular frame is established as a reference. The second order internal force analysis method is adopted, and the results are compared with the first order internal force analysis method. The results show that under the second-order analysis method, the second-order effect of high-rise steel frame structure mainly shows that the horizontal displacement of the structure increases, and the horizontal displacement above the irregular floor increases significantly. Under the second-order analysis, the horizontal displacement of beam column joints of high-rise steel frame structure increases by about 2% compared with the first order. For high-rise steel structures, the second-order analysis is more consistent with the actual stress situation. The disadvantageous effects of second-order effect should be fully considered in the design of high-rise steel frame structures.

articleTitle: Visualization analysis of comprehensive evaluation of academic papers based on knowledge graph
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Academic paper evaluation research has been the focus of scholars in recent years. This paper uses VOSviewer visualization software to show the world situation, overall development, hot research and development direction of the research field from the perspective of publication time, country distribution, institution distribution, important keywords distribution, journal distribution and so on. In this paper, a number of exquisite knowledge graphs are drawn to make the results more intuitive and clearer. The results can provide guidance and help for scholars in this field. This paper also provides suggestions for scholars to conduct follow-up research in this field.

articleTitle: A Study On Task-driven Blending Learning In Secondary Computer Courses
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The development of "Internet+" technology gives rise to blending learning with a combination of online and offline learning, which has become one of the important research directions for further exploration. To solve the problem of low participation and poor learning enthusiasm of students in blending learning, this paper applies modern computer technology to practical teaching activities based on the investigation in computer courses and explores digital learning resources recommendation for personalized learning with the task-driven teaching method. Specifically, the students are given interesting learning tasks before class which ignites their learning motivation, and then the students take part in learning activities with the problems found in pre-class learning which is helpful in improving class participation. Finally, we conducted comparative experiments and evaluated the actual teaching effectness with the novel teaching method and the traditional one respectively. The experimental results show that task-driven blending learning does help students achieve their learning objectives and the student's academic performance has been significantly improved comparing with the traditional teaching model in a control group.

articleTitle: Research on blended teaching reform based on computational thinking
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The outbreak of COVID-19 has impacted traditional teaching methods in schools, and blended teaching in the post-pandemic has gradually become a hot topic of research in higher education. Computational thinking, as one of the core literacies to be acquired in the 21st century, can help students realize the importance of computers as well as enable them to solve specific problems more effectively when facing real-life situations. The article takes the C language programming course as an example, analyzes the problems faced in teaching in the post-pandemic, introduces the concept of computational thinking and integrates it into all aspects of blended teaching design, pays attention to students' individual differences, and proposes a blended teaching model based on computational thinking and puts it into practice. The results show that this teaching model can improve students' learning performance, exercise students' computational thinking skills, and promote blended teaching reform and students' personalized development.

articleTitle: Implementation path of Nursing "Empathy" in Virtual Reality Teaching
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)v
abstract: In view of the shortage of clinical teaching resources, the disconnection of theory and practice, and the difficulties the nursing students be faced with in experiencing the psychological perception of different clinical scenarios and different roles, this paper discusses the teaching mode of "nursing empathy ability" based on different immersive virtual reality scene. Through the design of immersive scene experience and four stages of the teaching implementation, the teaching mode breaks the time and space limitation, realizes the combination of virtual and reality; creates the clinical empathy and practice experience of different scenes and roles; and connects theory with practice, emphasizes the practicality and landing of empathy ability, and improves students’ enthusiasm and initiative in learning.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Classroom Management System Based on AI + IOT Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the promulgation of the Education Informatization 2.0 Action Plan, a large number of smart classrooms have been built. As an important part of the smart classroom, the smart classroom control system directly determines the intelligent degree and convenience of the smart classroom equipment management. In recent years, the enrollment of colleges and universities has gradually increased, and the problems such as insufficient classroom location and waste of resources have become increasingly prominent. The classroom is an important place for the school to carry out teaching activities and students to learn. At present, the typical intelligent classroom control system has such solutions as controlling the equipment in the LAN through the PC terminal, controlling the equipment through the micro-controller, and controlling the equipment through the embedded system. In order to strengthen the management of the classroom, facilitate students to quickly query the available classroom and save classroom energy, an intelligent classroom management system is designed based on AI+IOT (Artificial intelligence + Internet of Things) technology. On one hand, the intelligent classroom management system can achieve regionalization automatic management of the lighting, fan, air conditioning in the classroom, on the other hand, it can also afford a fast query of free seats for students and a convenient classroom management for teachers. The main control chip of the system judges the state of seats in the classroom by collecting data from the seat pressure sensor, automatically switches lighting, fans and air conditioners, and transmits the data to the cloud server through WIFI module, so that the APP end and PC end can query seat information in the classroom. The intelligent classroom management system designed in this paper can greatly reduces the time for students to find free seats, affords a convenient classroom management for teachers and effectively solves the classroom electricity waste caused by carelessness. It plays an important role in the campus construction of colleges and universities.

articleTitle: Design and simulation of intelligent orchard system based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Based on the IVS simulation platform, the system uses IOT technology to monitor and control the environmental data onto greenhouse orchards for the purpose of orchard wisdom management. The system realizes the bi-directional function of manual remote as well as intelligent self-control through integrated sensors and wireless communication network, and optimizes through fuzzy control algorithm, PID algorithm and supervised learning algorithm to achieve the monitoring of data such as air temperature and humidity, soil temperature and humidity and carbon dioxide concentration in the park, so that the environment is always maintained in the range suitable for fruit tree growth. Finally, a QR code is added to each batch of fruits to build a traceability function of food safety.

articleTitle: Reversible Data Hiding Using Convolutional Neural Network and Digital Signal Processing Techniques
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Reversible data hiding is a data hiding process in which data is encrypted into an image as a means of authentication, and hidden data is used to hide the original image, and RDH is often used in areas where data authenticity and data preservation are important, such as legal/criminal investigations, medical images. In this study, this paper designed a novel reversible data hiding system that utilizes the Steghide algorithm to encrypt images and hide data, as well as an artificial neural network to recover embedded text and structure. Based on the analysis of the test results, it was concluded that the RDH scheme proposed in this article has the same or higher system accuracy and reliability as the existing RDH scheme. To further refine the system results in future studies, this paper proposes to increase the number of training iterations and the number of images in the training dataset to further improve the accuracy and reliability of the development.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation of Air Quality Based on Multiple Statistical Methods
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This paper aids to evaluate the relationship of different air pollutants and meteorological factors. This paper takes the data of Ji’nan as an example to extract 762 sample data based on the air quality monitoring data and related meteorological conditions information data from March 1, 2019 to March 31, 2021 released by China Meteorological Quality Monitoring Platform and the data network of China Meteorological Administration. Each sample data includes air quality index (AQI), fine particles (PM2.5), inhalable particulate matter (PM10), nitrogen dioxide (NO<inf>2</inf>), carbon monoxide (CO), sulfur dioxide (SO<inf>2</inf>) and the mean concentration of ozone (O<inf>3</inf>) change under light, and three meteorological factors: temperature, wind force and wind direction, then analyze their relationship with the SPSS. We can draw the following conclusions: the six major pollutants were first analyzed to extract the primary pollutant, PM2.5. Secondly, ARIMA (0,1,5) was constructed to simulate the future air quality index in Jinan. Finally, the temperature, wind force, wind direction and air quality index were analyzed respectively to explore its close relationship. Thus, it is necessary to suggest more targeted treatment to deal with air pollution.

articleTitle: Feature Fusion Network Based on Academic Content Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: At a time when academic achievements are being protected with emphasis the testing of academic contents has become a hot topic of much attention at present. In order to avoid the phenomenon of "multiple use of one image" and "image plagiarism" in the academic world, in view of the defects of insufficient feature fusion and low efficiency in the current target detection model, we propose a more powerful model method AIDPaper based on Faster R-CNN. AIDPaper adds PAFPN and DIoU Loss to the Faster R-CNN model. PAFPN is a bottom-up path added on top of FPN to greatly shorten the information propagation path and avoid information loss to a large extent. Subsequently, adaptive feature pooling is added to perform feature fusion for each regional proposal projected onto the feature layer to further enhance the fusion information of the features. DIoU loss provides the prediction direction for the prediction box making the regression more accurate not only speeding up the convergence but also reducing the detection time of the model. We perform experimental comparisons on the PaperImg dataset. The experimental results show that our proposed AIDPaper performs better and the mAP of AIDPaper is much higher than that of the baseline model Faster R-CNN at 3.2% ahead of Libra R-CNN at 6.1%. It has been shown experimentally that our model is more competitive compared to current detection models.

articleTitle: Individual Identification Algorithm of Known Emitters Based on Lightweight Binary Channels Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the traditional specific emitter identification method has poor feature extraction ability and limited recognition effect, this paper proposes a known specific emitter identification algorithm based on the LBCNet (the Lightweight Binary Channels Net). The algorithm uses bispectrum and cyclic spectrum to highlight the unintentional information in the pulse. Then, it combines the idea of depthwise separable convolution to design the LBCNet to realize adaptive feature extraction, fusion, and classification. Finally, it integrates the attention mechanism to highlight the effective information of the image, enhance the neural network’s learning ability and improve the identification performance of specific emitters. The simulation results show that the recognition rate of the proposed algorithm is as high as 94.53% at 0dB, which has good engineering practical value and can be applied to the field of electronic reconnaissance.

articleTitle: Educational Metaverse Dilemmas and Solutions: a stakeholder-based perspective
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The education metaverse has sparked a lot of attention as a new model for online education. But in the practical application of educational metaverse, there are often some contradictions and conflicts among multiple stakeholders, including the government, scientific and technological enterprises, and educational institutions. A challenge that needs to be resolved is how to build a high-quality and effective education metaverse environment while making sensible use of the new technological features of the education metaverse. Therefore, this article explores the basic connotation of the education metaverse from the perspective of stakeholders, discusses the current dilemmas faced by the education metaverse, and finally provides relevant solutions and advice to solve the problem.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of a novel campus face recognition access control system based on cloud-edge collaboration
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In recent years, face recognition access control has become a prerequisite for campus management. Compared with the traditional IC card mode, the face recognition access control system uses human biometrics as an essential reference for recognition verification, which greatly improves security. However, the use of face recognition and offline terminals such as access control systems leads to parallel pressure and excessive latency on the server. This behavior causes a disproportionate number of permissions when verifying permission information and information is sent out, far from the actual usage requirements. In this paper, we propose a novel cloud-edge collaborative face recognition access control method, which specifically addresses the scenario of schools with high real-time requirements for access control systems. It is worth mentioning that we proposed the online verification priority strategy has solved the excessive delay of verification when updating the bulk permission information. In addition, the server processing lightweight strategy in the system to alleviate the excessive parallel pressure on the server side.

articleTitle: SFR-Net:A Spatial Feature Enhance Method for Road Extraction
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In recent years, road remote sensing segmentation has become a necessary prerequisite for map modeling and urban planning. Convolutional neural networks have been widely used in the field of road remote sensing segmentation, and have achieved good performance. However, satellite road photography has the features of distinct objects and huge disparities, making it difficult to extract picture contextual information. We present a SFR-Net based on the mainstream encoder-decoder architecture, as well as an unique multi-scale information fusion enhancement module. The module is inserted between distinct scale features, modeling the interaction of features at different sizes in order to obtain remote sensing picture context information and effectively increase model segmentation precision. The model's performance is validated on CHN6-CUG in this paper, and the precision is enhanced by 1.12% compared to the current mainstream FCN-UNet. As a consequence, we are certain that SFR-Net will become a trustworthy baseline.

articleTitle: Research On Renova New Domestic Mechanical Detachable Coil System in Experimental Swine Aneurysm
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Objective: To establish an animal aneurysm model and use it to verify the operation performance, safety and effectiveness of Renova coil, a new domestic mechanical release coil system.Methods: Six healthy adult Guizhou swines were selected to make lateral aneurysm models on their common carotid artery by microsurgical suture. Renova coils were implanted immediately after angiography confirmation. Observe the operating performance of the coil during implantation. The occlusion of the aneurysm model immediately after the coil implantation and 6 months after embolization were evaluated by angiography. The specimens of the aneurysm model were examined pathologically.Results: The operating performance of coil were excellent. There were no complications such as perforation, displacement and thrombosis of parentartery. The immediate complete occlusion rate (Raymond-Roy Classification I) was 83.33%. The complete occlusion rate of aneurysm model was 100.00% after 6 months embolization. Pathology showed that the intima of the neck of the aneurysm model was completely closed and the lumen of the aneurysm model was tightly packed.Conclusion: Renova, a new domestic mechanical release coil system, has excellent performance in the main operation performance and use safety in the experiment of aneurysm model, and excellent performance in the immediate occlusion rate and 6-month occlusion rate of aneurysm model.

articleTitle: Design on Intelligent Smoke Alarm System
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The proportion of house fires in society is increasing day by day. Smoke alarm is of practical significance to prevent house fires and reduce losses caused by fire. Through careful study of the traditional smoke alarms, a new type of smoke alarm with safety, convenience and efficiency has been innovated. The traditional smoke alarms have many problems, such as complicated routing, high maintenance cost in the later stage, single notification object, inability to monitor in real time, and late warning or failure to warn. This paper puts forward a technical scheme that combines STM32 single-chip microcomputer with the Internet of Things NB-IOT and an APP. STM32 single chip microcomputer with the Internet of Things NB-IOT can solve the problems of tedious routing and single notification object. MQ-2 smoke sensor is adopted, which features high sensitivity. The A9500 wireless communication module refreshes data at high frequency and connects it to the cloud platform, thus greatly reducing the phenomenon of late warning and failure to warn. An APP application software, which can realize real-time monitoring and timely feedback of information at home. Users can put out the fire at the best time. This design starts from the reality of life and serves the needs of people so as to improve and innovate a new type of smoke alarm.

articleTitle: Multi-Attention Gate Based U-net For Retinal Vessel Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Retinal blood vessel segmentation images can be used to detect and evaluate various cardiovascular and ophthalmic diseases. However, due to the intricate vessel structures and blurred boundaries of vessels, it is a huge challenge to efficiently and accurately segment blood vessels. To deal with the above problems, this paper improves on the U-net by firstly using multi-scale feature convolution with kernels of varying size for feature extraction. Second, a non-local attention mechanism is applied to obtain richer global semantic information. Then multi-attention gate is used in the skip connection part by inputting feature maps of various scales and dimensions and selectively learning the interrelated regions, which improves the segmentation ability of the network model for the tiny structure of blood vessels. Quantitative and qualitative experimental results on two public datasets, DRIVE and CHASE_DB1, demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Exploration on the construction of the regional center of continuing medical education under the background of normalization of epidemic prevention and control
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)v
abstract: The COVID-19 epidemic is running at a high level globally, affecting all aspects of society, and medical education is no exception. With the rapid development of medical science, continuing medical education is an important way for medical workers to receive lifelong education. Meanwhile, attending continuing medical education is an inevitable requirement to ensure clinical ability. Under the background of normalization of epidemic prevention and control and the new situation of medical development, the management of continuing medical education in hospitals must follow the current situation and keep pace with the times. Therefore, the Internet support system to continuing education has emerged. This study used PDSA method to explore the construction of the regional center of continuing medical education through Internet under the background of normalization of epidemic prevention and control, aiming to promote the integration of medical education resources under the new situation, expand the learning channels of medical staff, and improve the level of medical education and teaching.

Author Keywords: normalization of epidemic prevention and control
the regional center of continuing medical education

articleTitle: Feature Generation Model for Imbalanced Classification Problems
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Class-imbalance learning deals with the problem where the number of training data in one class is significantly more than another class. To tackle this problem, some feasible and effective methods have been proposed in recent years. However, most of them are simply designed and cannot solve the essential difficulties embedded in the imbalanced data classification like noises and class overlapping. These problems make learning imbalanced data more difficult, but existing algorithms tend to ignore it and directly utilize intuitive class-wise resampling or reweighting to balance the dataset. To address these challenges, we propose a feature generation model, which mainly contains two parts: competitive learning and feature transformation. The experiments result on eight class-imbalance datasets show that the proposed method outperforms state-of-the-art approaches in class-imbalance learning task.

articleTitle: Function P-sets and Its Attribute Dependence of Information Law
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a new theory based on the function P-sets to ensure the security of dynamic information systems. Then, we introduce the law generation of function P-sets, attribute disturbance theorem of law, and law security theorem of P-sets. Further, information is encrypted by an encryption algorithm to ensure authenticity, prevent the disturbance of other data, and intercept and tamper with the information during the transfer process. This makes it easy to get the attribute value and obtain the hidden law through the proposed method. Finally, we give an application of the function P-set property dependence using the proposed method.

articleTitle: AENet: End-to-end training of Attention Efficientnet for stroke segmentation
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Medical image segmentation has extensive application and research value in medical research and practice fields, such as clinical diagnosis, pathological analysis, Operation Planning, image information processing, computer-assisted surgery, and so on. In the medical imaging of stroke, the lesions can be distributed in any area, and these lesions vary in size and shape. At present, various network frameworks have been used in deep learning for medical image segmentation, and good results have been achieved. However, the extremely small lesions in stroke images have serious neglect and false detection problems. To solve this problem, we design a loss function. This loss function optimizes the learning of semantic feature information around the target lesions, which can assist the network to locate small target regions more easily in the early stage of training. Meanwhile, it can add spatial information to assist the guidance network to achieve better convergence, accelerate network training, and finally improve the segmentation accuracy. In addition, we propose an end-to-end network structure, where the decoder adds the Attention Gates module to focus Attention on salient features that are useful for a particular task, the final prediction result is obtained by using the decoder structure to recover the spatial resolution. We sent the stroke images of different size lesions to the network for training by combining this network structure and the loss function we designed. The experimental results show that the DICE and NSD of our experimental data are improved effectively.

articleTitle: Computer-based Postgraduate Education and Discipline Construction in Light Chemical Engineering
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)v
abstract: The development of academic disciplines is the foundation of higher education institutions and is the core of their development. Postgraduate education is the top of higher education, representing the quality and level of the highest level of talents cultivated by higher education institutions, and is the original force for the construction of first-class disciplines. From the perspective of light chemical engineering majors, we do some exploring and thinking about the reform and development of postgraduate education in this field combined with computer. This paper analyzes the current situation of engineering education for postgraduate training of light chemical engineering majors and explores the postgraduate education mode for cultivating outstanding talents in light chemical engineering majors by combining computer-based education.

articleTitle: Monte Carlo simulation of light propagation in breast tissue
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Monte Carlo (MC) simulation of light propagation with 3D visualization platform can be used for image reconstruction. However, the complex structure and tissue inhomogeneity greatly increase the computing time of MC simulations. This study proposed a kind of improved cords of a voxelized type of MC software, to realize light propagation simulation in heterogeneous tissues with arbitrary geometric boundary. Validation studies on a realistic 3D female breast model show that the memories can be saved, time of parsing the file can be reduced and efficiency can be improved, indicating its great potential for biomedical optical applications.

articleTitle: Performance Improvement Strategy for Differentiated Services in Multi-rate IEEE 802.11 Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the wide application of wireless LAN, the real-time and differentiated services of IEEE 802.11 MAC are becoming more and more important. IEEE 802.11 uses CSMA/CA mechanism in MAC layer to coordinate access, but it does not meet the different requirements of different users for QoS. Considering the different requirements of different priority users for QoS, a solution is proposed for this problem. The core idea of this strategy is: in a multi rate network, according to the priority of nodes in the network, through adaptive optimization of relevant parameters, the probability of high priority nodes accessing the channel can be improved, and its throughput can be improved accordingly; The channel access probability of nodes with lower priority is reduced accordingly, and the throughput is reduced accordingly. Therefore, this policy can expand the throughput of each priority and realize the service differentiation function.

articleTitle: Case Design and Analysis of Digital Media Courses Incorporating Aesthetic Education
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In art universities, digital media general courses for undergraduates have a strong artistic university attribute. This paper designs a course case integrating aesthetic education. This case uses the scores of a group of short video works that have participated in the short video competition for college students as the data basis, and analyzes this case through a series of data processing. Comparing the actual ranking of the competition and the way students scored the short video works, while achieving the teaching goals and aesthetic education effects, the analysis shows that the final result ranking of the competition and the overall rating results given by the students are similar, which shows the objectivity and fairness of the competition, but the differences in details also show that the inconsistency between the public scores and the expert scores in the details. And all of these also indirectly indicates the importance of data analysis to real life.

articleTitle: Exploration on opening and sharing of large-scale instruments and equipment in universities
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In this study, we investigated the present situation and problems of the opening and sharing of large-scale instruments and equipment in universities by reviewing the development of opening and sharing of large-scale instruments and equipment at home and abroad. According to the practical experience of our university, we explored organizational system, regulation, platform of the opening and sharing instruments. Our work provides a reference for promoting and improving the development of open sharing management of large-scale instruments and equipment in the future.

articleTitle: Design and Construction of the New Web Learning System of Tsinghua University
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)v
abstract: Online learning platforms play an important role in supporting colleges and universities in integrating online and offline learning. The project team designed and developed the Web Learning System of Tsinghua University, which has become a basic supporting platform for teachers and students to carry out teaching and learning activities. The Web Learning System possesses functionalities such as course announcement management, courseware management, assignment management, discussion, Q & A, and online timetables, providing supporting services for course teaching, teacher-student interaction, and especially online and offline integrated learning during the COVID-19 pandemic.

articleTitle: Design of improved adaptive Kalman filter based on data fusion
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This paper designs a new adaptive Kalman filter (KF) to solve the filtering problem of with unknown noise statistics. The estimation error of the process noise covariance matrix will destroy the state estimation, and the state estimation error will reduce the estimation of the process noise covariance matrix, thus affecting the stability and optimality of the filter. In addition, most adaptive KF algorithms adopt the measurement method of single sensor, which is easy to cause the shortage of measurement data and affect the accuracy of the algorithm. Therefore, we propose a measurement sequence fusion adaptive Kalman filter (MSFAKF) algorithm to solve this series of problems. Based on MSFAKF algorithm, the estimation of process noise covariance and measurement noise covariance are obtained by measurement fusion sequence and innovation sequence respectively. Under certain conditions, the stability of MSFAKF algorithm is proved, and the filtering result converges to that of ideal KF with known second moment of noise. Simulation experiment shows that MSFAKF algorithm has the characteristics of fast convergence speed, high accuracy and strong adaptability.

articleTitle: A Novel Iris Segmentation Approach Using Spindle Ternary Tree
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This paper presents an accurate and novel iris segmentation approach. First rough iris region is extracted by boosted Local Binary Pattern features classifier. Follow Intensity gradient matrix is then built though gray gradient operator under polar coordinate. Then Special Ternary Tree model is proposed to handle the matrix for tracking iris boundaries by searching the best route as iris boundary. Comparatively, experimental results on the popular iris databases demonstrate that the proposed approach is accurate, efficient and robust.

articleTitle: Educational Data Mining and Learning Analysis System Based on Python
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Big data in education is of great significance to enhance students’ learning efficiency and improve teachers’ teaching quality, and is an important application of big data technology in the field of education.The purpose of this paper is to develop a Python-based educational data mining and learning analysis system.The advantages and shortcomings of educational data mining technology in the field of education are illustrated through the comparison of traditional education and online education and the application of related technologies at home and abroad.The basic framework of educational data mining and learning analysis system and the process of educational data mining and analysis are described, hoping to provide a reference for the research of online education system.

articleTitle: MSI: strain-level pathogen detection from nanopore metagenomic sequencing data
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Metagenomic sequencing is currently a common method of pathogen detection, capable of detecting all known and unidentified strains in a sample. Recently, nanopore sequencing has become a promising tool for rapid pathogen detection due to its rapid sequencing and long reads. However, identifying pathogens within a species is not easy for nanopore sequencing data due to the high sequencing error rate. To this reason, we developed the Metagenomic Strain Identification (MSI) tool, which can obtain species-specific readings and accurately screen candidate strains by using pan-genome method, thus overcoming the problems related to large reference genomic databases. Through experiments, we have verified that MSI can accurately identifies pathogen strains in samples in the presence of interfering strains.

articleTitle: Learning fine-grained modality-invariant feature via Wasserstein Distance for Visible-Thermal Person Re-Identification
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Visible-Thermal Person Re-identification(VT-ReID) focuses on matching query pedestrian images with the gallery sets, in which images of query and gallery sets are captured from different modalities. Compared with traditional person re- identification(Re-ID), VT-ReID concerns the additional cross- modality disparity caused by different spectrum cameras, in addition to intra-class variations. Existing VT-ReID methods commonly design the loss that is particularly for the global feature representations, which have limited the discriminability and ignored the relationship between the semantic parts. In this paper, we propose a novel Cross-modality Wasserstein Triplet Loss(CM-WTL) that can emphasize the semantic part and alleviate the modality discrepancy. This loss is based on the Wasserstein distance metric, which addresses the optimal transport problem by linear programming. It measures how much effort it would take to move the part-level embeddings to align two distributions, such that the distance between local features will be measured by obtaining an optimal transport matrix. In this manner, the obtained optimal transport matrix would assign different weights to relevant and irrelevant parts, resulting the alignment of local feature distribution. Therefore, our proposed CM-WTL can effectively mitigate the cross-modality discrepancy and learn the more fine-grained discriminative information. Extensive experimental results and comparisons demonstrate that our proposed method can achieve comparable performance with recent VT-ReID models.

articleTitle: Internet Information Service Algorithms Promoting High-quality Development of Digital Economy and Industry
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The new format of the digital economy (DE) has become an important tool for our country’s economic and social quality growth in the new era, and it has received extensive attention from all walks of life. How to use Internet information service algorithms to promote the high-quality growth of the DE and industry has become an important issue in the current era. This article aims to study the Internet information service algorithm to promote the high-quality growth of the DE and industry. It is based on the analysis of the characteristics of the DE, the growth trend of the DE, the common methods of the index system, the common recommendation methods and the principles of the construction of the index system. A comprehensive evaluation index system for the growth level of the DE was developed, and province S was taken as an example to evaluate the growth of its DE, and put forward relevant suggestions for the development of the DE.

articleTitle: Exploration and Research on Ideological and Political Teaching System of Linear Algebra
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)v
abstract: The ideological and political construction of curriculum is an important measure to build morality and cultivate people. Linear algebra is one of the most important common mathematics courses. The teaching team explored and constructed the ideological and political teaching system of the course from the following five aspects. According to the characteristics of the course, the teaching team established the goal of ideological and political education of the course; According to the course content, the teaching team excavated the ideological and political elements and established the ideological and political cases; According to the characteristics of students, the teaching team combined course teaching with information technology, implements a mixed teaching mode, optimizes teaching methods, and improves the quality of education; The teaching team explored the evaluation methods from four aspects: questionnaire, multi angle knowledge assessment, writing small papers, and group scoring; Excellent teaching cannot be separated from excellent teachers. We will strengthen the construction of excellent teacher teams from three aspects: theoretical learning, training and brainstorming. The establishment of the ideological and political teaching system of the curriculum provides necessary support for training high-quality talents.

articleTitle: Computer-assisted rigorous teaching for undergraduate students in light chemical engineering
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This paper discusses the development of rigorous teaching of light chemical engineering majors by combining intelligent teaching tools in undergraduate education. Based on the problems of using traditional teaching methods to teach professional courses in light chemical engineering, a computer-assisted rigorous teaching reform is carried out for undergraduate students by adopting a hybrid online and offline teaching mode. It mainly includes the enhancement of knowledge application ability, the auxiliary effect on the online and offline hybrid teaching, as well as the enrichment and improvement of assessment methods. It is not only conducive to cultivating undergraduate students' ability to link theory with practice and improve their thinking, but also connects course content with industry frontiers and research hotpots, expanding students' horizons and effectively improving teaching effectiveness and student training quality.

articleTitle: CMRI Segmentation Domain Generalization by Random Style Transfer
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: When training data and test data have different distribution, performance of neural networks may decrease significantly, and model is difficult to generalize knowledge. Domain generalization (DG) attempts to learn general and transferable knowledge from a variety of source domain data to enable the model to generalize to unseen domains. In this paper, considering both DG and few-shot scenario, we propose a random stylization block to augment existing styles through nonlinear combination of data, called style escape, so as to obtain more unseen styles for the model to learn consistency. We propose a heuristic gradient weighting strategy to optimize the training process of meta-learning model. The experimental results on M&Ms dataset show that segmentation performance of our model is significantly improved compared with baselines, and the model training cost is noticeably reduced, which fully verifies the effectiveness of our method.

articleTitle: Application Research of Computer-Assisted Primary School Mathematics Teaching
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the vigorous development of information technology, the modern education reform in China has also achieved remarkable results. By combining computer-assisted education with the primary school mathematics teaching, it has changed the single traditional teaching method in primary school mathematics classroom. The use of multimedia computer technology can create a variety of teaching modes for students, enrich the content of the primary school mathematics classroom, mobilize students’ interest in learning, and further improve the quality and efficiency of classroom teaching. The use of computer technology in mathematics teaching has become an important issue for educators to consider. Therefore, this paper explains the advantages of computer-assisted teaching, analyses the current situation of primary school mathematics classroom teaching under information technology, and proposes corresponding countermeasures for the innovation of computer-assisted teaching mode. It is hoped that it can provide reference and reference for educators and further promote the reform of primary school mathematics teaching.

articleTitle: Water Level Prediction based on Conditional Generation Adversarial Network
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Improving the prediction accuracy of water levels is of great significance to water resources scheduling, flood control, and disaster reduction. Deep learning-based recurrent neural networks variants have proved to be a powerful algorithmic model for water level prediction. However, few people use generation adversarial network to mine water level time series information. In this work, we propose a simple and effective method (termed WLP-ForGAN) for watershed multi-point Water Level Prediction based on Conditional Generative Adversarial Networks. Through the adversarial training of the generator and discriminator, the predicted data is constantly close to the real data, to realize the prediction of time series, and improve the utilization of limited data information of the model. The attention module is embedded in the WLP-ForGAN network structure of the generator and discriminator, so that the WLP-ForGAN model can autonomously assign the attention weight value to the input series vectors according to the hydrological information in the input features. Extensive experiments on real datasets show that the proposed WLP-ForGAN consistently outperforms commonly used models, which proves the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Analysis Platform of Student Learning Data Combined with Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: At present, most teaching platforms based on artificial intelligence are designed to launch learning tasks for students. However, those teaching platforms are less to analyze the knowledge mastery of students and less to carry out personalized and accurate teaching according to the learning situation. Teachers using those platforms generally check the learning situation of the whole student in a coarse granularity, which will lead to the lack of data analysis and learning situation of a single student, and therefore there is no feedback to adjust the teaching strategy. Those factors contribute to the insufficiency of communication and interaction between teachers and students. The effect of online teaching is inferior to offline teaching. In this paper, we proposed a learning platform that combines artificial intelligence. This platform aims to strengthen teachers' control over students' learning process and help teachers improve their teaching strategies. This paper combines deep learning technology with computer vision to collect data and analyze students' learning status, using machine algorithms to achieve identity binding and data feedback. Finally, we also established the environment for big data for the future expansion of data analysis functions.

articleTitle: Vehicle Detection in UAV Remote Sensing Image Based on Improved YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of vehicle detection in UAV remote sensing images, adaptive anchor frame calculation is used to seek the optimal initial value anchor frame, the loss function of YOLOv5 algorithm which only uses the length width ratio of the bounding box and cannot reflect the real difference between the width and height of the bounding box and its real value, is improved. It eliminates the problem of slow convergence caused by the failure to reflect the real difference in width and height. Using this improved YOLOv5 algorithm for training and detection, the effectiveness of the algorithm for vehicle detection in UAV aerial images is verified.

articleTitle: Metaverse Teaching Overview
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: 2021 is known as the "epoch-making year" of the metaverse, and "Metaverse + Education" has become one of the focus issues for educational researchers. As an important aspect of "Metaverse Education", "Metaverse Teaching" has caught worldwide attention.
