Based on "Metaverse Teaching", this paper begins with the concepts of "Metaverse Education", "Metaverse Teaching" and "Metaverse Teaching Design", introduces the characteristics of "Metaverse Teaching", and further analyzes the underlying logic of "Metaverse Teaching" from four aspects: contemporary theories of education, the ultimate goal of teaching designs, the development trend of education informatization and the development goal of lifelong education. The application of "Metaverse Teaching" in teaching management, ideological and political education, the design and development of teaching resources, and teaching evaluation is expounded next. Finally, it disserts the field architecture and technical support of "Metaverse Teaching".

articleTitle: Current Situation and Thinking of the Career Values and Career Planning of Postgraduates in Colleges and Universities
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Under the structural contradiction of employment, in order to help the graduate students occupy an advantage in the employment market, the systematic graduate students' professional values and career planning are required. This paper adopts the graduate career values and career planning scale, taking the graduate students in South China University of Technology as an example, and adopts the sampling survey to investigate and analyze the current situation of the graduate students' career values and career planning. The study uses principal component analysis to divide the occupational values into the job belonging, the self-realization and the social status dimensions. The career planning is divided into the specific planning and the general planning. The study found that the gender, the grade, the major and the internship experience had an impact on career values and career planning, while the place of origin had no impact on them, and that the formation of the professional values has a greater impact on the general career planning. Finally, we put forward some ideas such as clarifying the role of tutors in cultivating people, systematizing the graduate career education, accurately screening the graduate employment guidance needs, and expanding the service scope of the employment guidance departments.

articleTitle: A Defense Method against Backdoor Attacks in Neural Networks Using an Image Repair Technique
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the rapid development of deep learning research and applications, the problem of artificial intelligence security has become increasingly prominent, such as adversarial examples, universal adversarial patch, and data poisoning, especially for the backdoor attack, which is a new type of covert attack, leading to the vulnerability and non-robustness of deep learning models. In a backdoor attack, the attacker will conduct a malicious attack by inserting some poisoned samples into training dataset. Poisoned samples add triggers and modify the labels to the target labels to participate in the training. Infected model has the same accuracy as the clean model in the normal test set, but when confronted with poisoned samples, the triggers will be activated to make the infected model predict the target label. To solve this problem, model parameters adjustment and poisoned data removal methods are widely used. However, they lack real-time performance and accuracy is insufficient. In this paper, we propose a new backdoor attack defense method, in which trigger reverse engineering is used to obtain the right triggers and image repair techniques to make sure that the input model data can be real-time processed without any negative impacts on clean samples.

articleTitle: Comparative study of Transfer Learning and VGGNet based classification of Alzheimer's disease
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Alzheimer’s disease is one of the most well-known irreversible dementias most often at the old age. Thus, the prevention in the earliest stage is the key to tackle this problem. Recent researches indicate that deep learning and convolution neural networks have an edge over the diagnosis of Alzheimer’s disease. In this study, the Alzheimer’s disease is classified into 4 types (NonDemented, VeryMildDemented, MildDemented and ModerateDemented) according to the severity of their symptoms and many CNN models were compared and it is found that VGG19 with accuracy of 86.84% shows an excellent ability among them. With series of enhancements on VGG19, the accuracy of this model is improved to 90.52%.

articleTitle: Named entity recognition of TCM electronic medical records based on the ALBERT-BiLSTM-CRF model
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: TCM electronic medical records contain a plethora of valuable clinical information. In this paper, the named entity recognition (NER) of TCM electronic medical records of orthopedics is studied based on the ALBERT-BiLSTM-CRF model. Based on the ALBERT pre-trained language model, the labeled data are encoded to complete the word embedding and obtain dynamic word vectors. Then, BiLSTM is applied to fully understand the context semantics. Finally, the concatenated vector is input to the CRF layer and decoded by the Viterbi algorithm to study NER. The model constructed in this paper recognizes four types of entities, i.e., clinical manifestations, body parts, TCM syndrome types, and TCM disease names, with F1 values of 98.31%,95.00%, 97.48%, and 99.96%, respectively. The precision rate, recall rate, and F1 value of overall entity recognition are 98.39%, 97.16% and 97.76%, respectively. As compared with the BERT-RNN-CRF, BERT-GRU-CRF, and BERT-BiLSTM-CRF models, the proposed model shows improvements in terms of precision rate, recall rate, and F1 value. In addition, the proposed model is capable of efficiently accomplishing entity recognition tasks, thus making it more suitable for the NER task of TCM electronic medical records.

articleTitle: The mental health benefits and feasibility of the smartphone-based interpretation bias modification training in working population
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This is the first study to explore the effect of interpretation bias modification training app on the stress, anxiety and depression of working population, and evaluate its feasibility. The working people were divided into training group(TG) and control group(CG). The TG received positive interpretation bias modification training using an app on their smartphone. The training ;frequency is 3 to 5 times a week, 5 to 10 minutes each time. It takes about 2.5 months to 3 months to complete all 30 trainings. The CG was not trained The levels of stress, anxiety and depression were assessed before and after training. The completion rate and positive evaluation rate of the TG were calculated to evaluate the feasibility. Results: ①Stress: after training, there was a significant difference in the amount of change between the TG and the CG. ② Anxiety: after training, the anxiety score of the TG decreased significantly, while that of the CG did not change significantly. ③ Depression: after training, the depression score of the TG did not change significantly, while that of the CG increased significantly. ④ To the TG, the training completion rate was 62.22%, and the positive evaluation rate was 62.96%, indicating that the training method is feasible. Conclusion: Interpretation bias modification training app can reduce the stress, anxiety and depression and improve the mental health level of working population. This method is feasible and worth popularizing.

articleTitle: To explore the prevention and treatment of diabetic vascular diseases based on "Yingwei theory"
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)v
abstract: Objective: To explore the prevention and treatment of diabetic vascular diseases based on "Yingwei theory". Methods: Referring to some literatures of CNKI from 2001 to 2021, related researches on diabetic vascular diseases were carried out through "Ying Wei Theory", and the key words were "diabetes; Yingwei theory; Compound Chinese medicine; Single Chinese medicine; Vascular disease; Arteriosclerosis;" , 21 literatures were selected. Results: Through the understanding of the influence of diabetes on cardiovascular disease, the relationship between Yingwei theory and vascular disease, the relationship between Yingwei theory and atherosclerosis of diabetes. Yingwei theory in vascular disease and diabetes vascular disease related basic research, clinical research. The results showed that the "Yingwei theory" could relieve vascular endothelial function, regulate autonomic nerve remodeling, resist inflammation, reverse fibrosis, inhibit oxidative stress and improve cardiac function. Clinical application can improve unstable angina pectoris and other cardiovascular diseases. Conclusion: Ying Methodism can be used to treat diabetes mellitus and its complicated vascular diseases.

articleTitle: Mental health status of high school students impacted by COVID-19<sub-title>A latest MSSMHS-60 investigation to 626 Dongguan high school students
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)v
abstract: As the normalization of the COVID-19 epidemic, trying to objectively present mental health status of high school students, to make comparisons with the history data for developing changes and to analyze how the epidemic been affected, the investigation has adopted stratified random sampling methods by randomly selected 5 classes from each grade of a Dongguan high School. Total 15 classes of 626 students participated and been evaluated by filling the questionnaire "Mental Health Scale for Middle School Students (MSSMHS-60)". 582 valid inputs were collected as the database, using SPSS 23.0 to carry out descriptive statistics, independent sample t-test and one-way ANOVA with the relevant 2019 historical data from Chen Dan Beijing Youth Legal and Psychological Counseling Service Center for comparisons. The investigation and statistical results indicated: the overall mental health level of high school students have demonstrated an obvious negative trend during the COVID-19 epidemic, the latest problem detection rate 39.86% is much higher than 26.3% in 2019. Among all the factors, "Study Pressure", "Emotional Volatility" and "Anxiety" ranked the top three mental health problems. The mental health status of boys seems better than girls, while the mental health status of students in Grade One is better than students in Grade Three. The mental health status of students in Grade Three is the most critical, which manifested in serious problems on "Study pressure", "Anxiety" and "Emotional Fluctuation" factors.

articleTitle: CMHS:Feature selection based on harmony search algorithm with cosine and momentum control factor
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Selecting the optimal subset from high-dimensional features can improve the algorithm’s efficiency and performance for data mining tasks while also avoiding the overfitting phenomenon. Some works have improved the harmony search(HS) algorithm to handle the challenge of finding the appropriate feature subset. These algorithms, however, are still suffering from an imbalance between global optimization and convergence accuracy. In this paper, we propose and evaluate a harmony search algorithm based on cosine and momentum control factors (CMHS) for feature selection. We incorporate the cosine similarity between harmonic vectors into the dynamic smoothing adjustment strategy of the HS’s control parameters and design a novel fitness function to overcome the mentioned problem. We compared the accuracy of seven UC datasets side by side, and the average accuracy of CMHS is 96.49%, higher than the 93.78% of NGHS and the 93.33% of IBGHS. Moreover, when compared to NGHS and IBGHS, the fitness value of CMHS decreases by 25% on average, indicating that our proposed improvement strategy strikes a reasonable balance between global optimization and convergence accuracy, allowing CMHS to display more steady performance in the feature selection task.

articleTitle: Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (DDPG)-based Photovoltaic Power Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The uncertainty and randomness of large-scale photovoltaic (PV) generation will seriously affect the safety and economy of the power systems. In order to mitigate the negative impact of grid-connected solar PV, it is important to accurately predict PV power. In view of this, this paper first proposes a novel hybrid method based on non-pooling convolutional neural network and deep deterministic policy gradient (DDPG) for ultra-short-term PV power forecasting. The DDPG model is used to implement the feature training task, and the NPCNN model is introduced into DDPG’s actor network to learn action strategies for partially observed problems in complex environments. The proposed method is extensively evaluated on real PV data in Limburg, Belgium. Numerical results show that the proposed method can provide good forecasting performance in different seasons and forecasting horizons.

articleTitle: Computable-oriented Characteristics Representation of Online Learners from the Perspective of Heterogeneous Network
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The accuracy of learner characteristics analysis has long been an issue in existing learner models. In order to enhance the accuracy and to get the multi-dimensional personalized characteristics of learners, a learner characteristics analysis based on the perspective of heterogeneous network was proposed in this paper. Network embedding method was adopted to realize the computability of learner modeling, in which multi-dimensional characteristics of learners have been divided into explicit characteristic database and potential implicit characteristic database. A heterogeneous learning network composed of learner social network, content network and association network among attributes has been constructed, which integrated different multi-dimensional interaction information for learner modeling. The analysis of heterogeneous learning network examples reveals that the computable method facilitates the extraction of specific learner characteristics and provides new methods for learner modeling.

articleTitle: Unsupervised Time Series Anomaly Detection under Data Contamination
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Unsupervised learning utilizes unlabeled data to alleviate the reliance on large amounts of labeled data, and it has made great progress in time series anomaly detection. However, there are still some thorny issues unsolved, especially the incapability to maintain the robustness of the model when the time series dataset is contaminated. In this work, we propose an unsupervised time series anomaly detection method on data contamination, named distribution alignment autoencoder (DAAE), in which a temporal sliding reward function combines the adversarial distribution alignment to mine the contaminated data. Specifically, the dimensionality reduction and reconstruction of the time series are implemented by an autoencoder. Next, using two discriminators, the latent features obtained by dimensionality reduction are mapped to the Gaussian distribution, and the high-confidence normal time series are generated by sampling noise from the Gaussian distribution. Then, we compute the mean square error between high-confidence normal samples and the training data. Finally, we feed the error values to the temporal sliding reward function to mine the contaminated training samples. Experimental results compared with baselines on public datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of DAAE.

articleTitle: Review of flipped classroom model based on Microcourse
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: With the organic integration of Internet + education, the structure and form of education and teaching system are changing and transforming. In order to effectively improve the connotation and extension of educational service, it is necessary to explore the effective implementation strategy of flipped classroom This paper analyzes the practical strategy of flipped classroom from five aspects: the theoretical basis, goal orientation, operation procedure, support system and evaluation system, and compares the teaching mode of similar flipped classroom The research shows that using micro-course to present knowledge and implementing flipped classroom can effectively promote the effective use and research of teaching resources, and form a new mixed teaching mode with students as the main body.

articleTitle: Research on automatic text clustering method based on Improved PSO
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: There are some problems in the field of text clustering and particle swarm optimization (PSO) technology, for example, the researchers need to determine the appropriate number of clusters before clustering, the clustering results are sensitive to the initial cluster center, and the PSO algorithm has precocious convergence and easy to fall into local optimality defects. We propose a dynamic topology adaptive PSO (DTA-PSO) algorithm that combines the K-means algorithm PSO to realize automatic text clustering. In DTA-PSO, we adopt an improved comprehensive dynamic learning strategy from social group experience the source of the social experience of the particle group is not only the particle with the best performance among all its neighbors, according to the performance of all its neighbors and the relative position with the particle, the target position is calculated in the next iteration. We choose three data sets in the knowledge base of the machine learning open data set and part of the Chinese corpus of Fudan University. Many experiments are carried out on the automatic cluster of DTA-PSO, the text automatic clustering algorithm has a certain improvement on the K value determination and the clustering effect by the contrast analysis.

articleTitle: Recommendation Algorithm Based on Object Feature Combination Embedded
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)v
abstract: With the explosive growth of online learning resources, in order to enable learners to acquire learning materials more accurately, we propose a recommendation algorithm based on object feature combination embedded and knowledge graph. Firstly, the student predictive performance ability model based on Item Response Theory(IRT) was used to identify learners’ abilities reliably, and to model and infer the relevance of knowledge points. Secondly, a recommendation algorithm based on object feature combination embedded and knowledge graph is used to effectively recommend learning materials through multidimensional information of learners and projects. Finally, we propose a modified algorithm for knowledge graph and student ability based on EM algorithm, this algorithm is used to further modify the learner’s ability and the actual difficulty of the test after training, so as to optimize the effect of the next recommendation, which effectively improves the effectiveness of recommendation under sparse data and cold start. According to the analysis of experimental results, our proposed recommendation algorithm can maintain a precision of about 60% in a small training set and maintain a response speed of about 1s to users.

articleTitle: Analysis of electricity service evaluation based on multi-mode heterogeneous data fusion
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The electricity Internet of Things (IoT) generates a large amount of heterogeneous data under the edge cloud topology. The rational use of the heterogeneous data of the electricity Internet of Things can effectively improve the benefits of electricity enterprises. User service evaluation is a key indicator reflecting the good or bad service quality of the enterprise, and accurate identification of user sentiment is an important reference for subsequent service adjustment of the enterprise. In this paper, a distributed cloud computing-based data collection framework is proposed, which has the advantages of low cost and fast collection, and provides a physical basis for effective integration of multi-source heterogeneous data resources. In addition, this paper also proposes an emotion recognition method based on user evaluation of audio and text multimodal data fusion, constructs BiLSTM-Transformer and CNN-BiLSTM models for text and audio emotion analysis respectively, then uses self-assignment fusion strategy to realize decision fusion and verifies its efficient performance on the dataset.

articleTitle: A Study on The Impact of Low-carbon Dual-channel Supply Chain Decisions Based on Product Network Externalities
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In the low-carbon dual-channel supply chain system led by manufacturers, the influence of network externalities that products have on the reduction level of carbon emissions, product pricing, and optimal profit of each node firm is explored. Based on Stackelberg's game theory, a low-carbon dual-channel supply chain decision model with network externalities is constructed respectively in the centralized decision making and decentralized decision making, and the decision model is solved by using the inverse induction method. The study shows that under the centralized or decentralized decision mode, the carbon emission reduction level per unit product increases, the retail price and direct sales price of the product increases, and the overall profit of the low-carbon dual-channel supply chain increases as the product network externality increases; under the decentralized decision mode, the decision efficiency loss of the low-carbon dual-channel supply chain increases as the product network externality increases. Finally, according to the research findings, some suggestions are proposed for decision makers.

articleTitle: Learning Specific Features for KOA Diagnosis: Autoencoder Network vs. Feature Selection
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Knee osteoarthritis (KOA) is a degenerative joint disease that seriously affects patients’ quality of life. Due to the global aging population and obesity, the number of people living with KOA is expected to increase. Although KOA is the dominant disease in Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM), the clinical diagnosis is currently made by Western medicine based on the patient's medical history, signs and symptoms, and image examinations. This study aims to find specific features for KOA using deep autoencoder and traditional feature selection, thus providing a diagnosis reference and exploring the advantages and disadvantages of both approaches and their interpretability.

articleTitle: Global Adaptive Output Regulation for Nonlinear Systems with Unknown Control Directions and Prescribed Performance
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: This paper addresses the problem of global adaptive prescribed performance output regulation for uncertain nonlinear systems. It is assumed that the system states, the exosystems parameters, and the control direction are unknown, which poses challenges in the design of control algorithm. Adaptive control, prescribed performance control, and internal model principle are employed to solve the global output regulation problem for uncertain nonlinear systems. The controller is designed such that the system states and the trajectory of the control law exist and are bounded, while the tracking error asymptotically approaches the origin with guaranteed prescribed control performance.

articleTitle: An infrared small target detection method based on non-local similarity
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The infrared image in the sea background usually contains random noise, sea waves, fish scale light and other clutter. Sea waves and fish scale light interference are similar to small infrared targets, so it is difficult to eliminate such interference and detect small infrared targets quickly and accurately. In this paper, a small target detection method based on non-local similarity is proposed. The interference is eliminated by using the class feature similarity of interference and the overall feature uniqueness of the small target. Firstly, this paper performs filtering to remove random noise, and the suspected small targets can be extracted by executing Top Hat filtering. Secondly, a multi-feature vector is constructed for all suspected targets. Finally, this paper analyzes the characteristics of different interference and executes clustering step by step. The wave edge interference and fish scale light interference can be eliminated in turn. Feature threshold is set based on the interference that has been identified to obtain the true small infrared target according to the uniqueness of the characteristics of the true target. The experimental results show that compared with other small target detection algorithms, the proposed algorithm can detect small infrared targets in complex sea background effectively.

articleTitle: Clustering Compression of Object-Induced Three-Way Concept Lattice in Fuzzy Formal Context
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In order to improve the effectiveness of fuzzy three-way concept lattice information extraction, this paper proposes a fuzzy three-way concept lattice clustering compression method based on fuzzy three-way concept information system. By studying the relationship between fuzzy three-way concept and attributes, the diversity factor of fuzzy three-way concepts under each attribute is defined to obtain the distance between fuzzy three-way concepts. Aiming at the problem that it is difficult to find cluster center in system clustering, we give a method of selecting cluster center and discuss a system clustering algorithm based on fuzzy three-way concept. Finally, K-deletion transformation under fuzzy formal context is analyzed, and a compressed lattice containing the original concept is established. Experiments show the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Time Slot Algorithm Based on Throughput Optimization in IEEE 802.11 Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In IEEE 802.11 wireless LAN, as the number of nodes increases, collisions will increase correspondingly, channel utilization will decline, and the total throughput will decline instead of increasing, leading to system performance degradation. Through in-depth analysis of the root cause of this problem, this paper designs a simple and effective algorithm, which uses ARMA filtering algorithm to measure the conditional collision probability and then calculate the number of nodes in the network. The AP tells all nodes in the network in the form of broadcast when the number of nodes in the network changes, after all nodes receive the broadcast sent by the AP, they dynamically adjust the network parameters accordingly. Finally, NS2 simulation software is used to conduct simulation experiments in a variety of network scenarios, and the experimental results verify that the algorithm in this paper is simple and effective, with less changes to IEEE 802.11, and is suitable for use and promotion in wireless networks. It can optimize the network system performance based on the number of nodes, improve the system throughput, and significantly improve the network performance. According to the number and density of nodes, the algorithm reduces the collision probability by dynamically adjusting the timeslot, accordingly increases the total network throughput, and achieves the purpose of effectively improving the network performance.

articleTitle: NAGNet: A Convolutional Neural Network for Real-Time Sentiment Analysis of Students
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Students' emotional state during class can reflect their understanding of classroom knowledge. Analysing the emotional data of students is helpful for ensuring that teachers understand students' learning effect and improve their teaching quality. With the rapid development of information education, student emotion analysis has been widely studied in the field of educational technology. However, due to the complexity and inconsistency of educational scenes, traditional facial expression recognition algorithms have low accuracy, losing information while extracting facial expression features, and student emotion analysis faces several technical issues. Therefore, based on the theory of deep learning, this paper proposes a novel network model NAGNet for recognizing and analysing students' expressions in classroom environments, to assist teachers in carrying out reasonable teaching effect evaluations. In this model, Res2Net50 is used as the backbone network to enhance the feature extraction ability of the model. Moreover, non-local attention module is added to integrate the global facial expression feature information to achieve fine-grained sentiment analysis. In addition, we replace the original pooling algorithm with generalized mean (GeM) pooling to pool the features of the last layer. The experimental results on the public affection dataset FERPlus, which includes eight emotions, show that the NAGNet model achieves an accuracy of 89.3%. Thus, the proposed model has higher accuracy than existing methods. In a real-world application scenario, the NAGNet model can analyse and detect students' emotions in real time. What's more, it has good robustness.

articleTitle: The Effect of Time Pressure on Static and Dynamic Visual Search Performance Based on Eye Movement Data
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)v
abstract: Static visual search and dynamic visual search are two categories of visual search that have previously been studied separately. This study aimed to ascertain the effect of time pressure on both static and dynamic visual search performance. We conducted an experiment using eye tracking to study search performance under 5 kinds of time pressure. The results identified time pressure has different effects on static and dynamic visual search. The study confirmed that low time pressure promotes static visual search performance while high time pressure inhibits it. Besides when the time pressure is high, the differences between static and dynamic visual search performance are significant. The results show that time pressure can affect the performance of visual search, which can provide guidance on the timing of automated search in situations such as illegal items inspection in stations and airports and manual inspection of defective products in the factory.

articleTitle: Reform of Cultivating Practical Innovation Ability in Computer Science
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: The traditional way of training talents in higher education institutions can no longer meet the requirements of the industry any more. A perfect training mode should be established and improved timely. In this paper, we proposed a practical innovation ability cultivation mode of "competition as the driving force, industry guidance as the auxiliary wing, and scientific research training as the advantage". In this mode, the target ability indicators and professional knowledge are gradually run through in all practical teaching links. Within the last three years, the students who participated in the multi-level progressive practice teaching mode have achieved numerous progresses and achievements. Combining industry, competition and scientific research, students' innovation ability in practice is gradually improved, the effect of the current modified training mode is obvious, and the students' practical application ability is improved significantly.

articleTitle: An Empirical Analysis on the Changes of Household Consumption Structure in Shandong Province Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: In this paper, under the background of big data technology, the data of the income and consumption expenditure of urban and rural residents in Shandong Province and the whole country from 2008 to 2021 are selected for comparative analysis. Firstly, the income and consumption status of urban and rural residents in Shandong Province are compared and analyzed, and then the ELES model is used for empirical analysis. Finally, the characteristics and existing problems of residents' consumption structure in Shandong Province are summarized based on various data, and suggestions are given to promote the rationalization of consumption structure.

articleTitle: Transfer Extreme Learning Machine with Cross Domain Mean Approximation Projection
publicationTitle: 2022 12th International Conference on Information Technology in Medicine and Education (ITME)
abstract: Traditional extreme learning machine (ELM) with the advantages of fast speed and high precision, is widely used in pattern recognition and machine learning. However, it has two shortcomings: 1) Its accuracy decreases greatly under lack of available training samples. 2) The performance is greatly affected by the initialization of hidden-layer parameters. To solve the above two problems, we propose a novelty ELM named transfer extreme learning machine with cross domain mean approximation projection (TELM-CDMAP). It first uses cross domain mean approximation (CDMA) to project input data into feature subspace instead of the data transformation from input-layer to hidden-layer. Then, we apply a between-domain scatter matrix (BDSM) term into the hidden-layer and solve the optimal output weight with the ability of knowledge transfer. The classification experiments on Office+Caltech object recognition and USPS+MNIST digital handwriting datasets are carried out and the result show the effectiveness of our ELM models.
